edition_title.en: Windows CNG and PKCS#11 expand while JSON and socket safety defects are closed
edition_title.fr: Windows CNG et PKCS#11 progressent tandis que des défauts JSON et socket sont corrigés
edition_title.zh: Windows CNG 与 PKCS#11 扩展，同时修复 JSON 和 socket 安全缺陷
edition_title.ru: Windows CNG и PKCS#11 расширены, исправлены дефекты безопасности JSON и сокетов

intro.en: This large cryptography-focused edition introduces a Windows CNG certificate-store backend, completes RSA envelope decryption through CNG and PKCS#11 keys, and repairs a long PKCS#11 import/signing lifecycle sequence. Outside cryptography, it closes an out-of-bounds JSON logging read, bounds a socket retry loop, fixes reverse-proxy session-cookie selection and adds distinct HTTP connect, send and receive timeouts.
intro.fr: Cette édition largement consacrée à la cryptographie introduit un backend de certificats Windows CNG, complète le déchiffrement d’enveloppes RSA via CNG et PKCS#11 et répare une longue séquence d’import/signature PKCS#11. Elle corrige aussi une lecture JSON hors limites dans les logs, borne une boucle socket, fiabilise le cookie de session derrière proxy et sépare les timeouts HTTP de connexion, d’envoi et de réception.
intro.zh: 本期以密码学为主：新增 Windows CNG 证书存储后端，完成通过 CNG 与 PKCS#11 私钥解密 RSA envelope，并修复一系列 PKCS#11 导入、签名和生命周期问题。此外还修复 JSON 日志越界读取、限制 socket 重试循环、修正反向代理后的会话 cookie 选择，并拆分 HTTP connect/send/receive timeout。
intro.ru: В этом крупном криптографическом выпуске появился backend хранилища сертификатов Windows CNG, завершено расшифрование RSA-envelope через ключи CNG и PKCS#11 и исправлена длинная серия проблем импорта, подписи и жизненного цикла PKCS#11. Также устранено чтение за границами при JSON-логировании, ограничен socket retry, исправлен session cookie за reverse proxy и разделены HTTP connect/send/receive timeouts.

en: Add mormot.crypt.win to uses if code references TAesAbstractApi or its CryptoAPI AES descendants, which moved out of mormot.crypt.core.
Windows gains TCryptCertAlgoCng, ICryptCertCng and TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 for store, smart-card/KSP and transient PFX identities.
PKCS#11 gains RSA envelope decryption and broader signing support, but TPkcs11 is explicitly no longer thread-safe; shared catalog access must use TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock.
Upgrade promptly for the TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer over-read, TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv endless retry, CNG/PKCS#11 GPFs and OpenSSL ABI corrections.
THttpClientSocket.SetTimeouts now separates connect, send and receive budgets; TRestHttpClientSocket applies all three.
fr: Ajoutez mormot.crypt.win aux uses si le code référence TAesAbstractApi ou ses descendants CryptoAPI AES, déplacés depuis mormot.crypt.core.
Windows reçoit TCryptCertAlgoCng, ICryptCertCng et TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 pour les stores, cartes/KSP et identités PFX transitoires.
PKCS#11 reçoit le déchiffrement RSA envelope et davantage de signatures, mais TPkcs11 n’est plus thread-safe ; protégez le catalogue avec TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock.
Mettez à niveau pour la lecture hors limites de TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer, la boucle infinie de TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv, les GPF CNG/PKCS#11 et les corrections ABI OpenSSL.
THttpClientSocket.SetTimeouts sépare les budgets connect, send et receive ; TRestHttpClientSocket applique les trois.
zh: 若代码引用 TAesAbstractApi 或其 CryptoAPI AES 子类，请在 uses 中加入 mormot.crypt.win；这些类型已从 mormot.crypt.core 移出。
Windows 新增 TCryptCertAlgoCng、ICryptCertCng 与 TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12，支持系统 store、smart card/KSP 和临时 PFX identity。
PKCS#11 新增 RSA envelope 解密与更多签名支持，但 TPkcs11 明确不再 thread-safe；共享 catalog 必须使用 TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock。
应尽快升级以修复 TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer 越界读取、TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv 无限重试、CNG/PKCS#11 GPF 及 OpenSSL ABI 问题。
THttpClientSocket.SetTimeouts 现在分别设置 connect、send 与 receive 时限；TRestHttpClientSocket 会应用三者。
ru: Добавьте mormot.crypt.win в uses, если код обращается к TAesAbstractApi или его CryptoAPI AES-потомкам: они перенесены из mormot.crypt.core.
Windows получает TCryptCertAlgoCng, ICryptCertCng и TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 для store, smart-card/KSP и временных PFX identities.
PKCS#11 получает RSA-envelope decryption и больше алгоритмов подписи, но TPkcs11 больше не thread-safe; общий каталог защищайте TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock.
Обновитесь ради исправлений TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer over-read, бесконечного TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv retry, GPF в CNG/PKCS#11 и OpenSSL ABI.
THttpClientSocket.SetTimeouts разделяет connect, send и receive budgets; TRestHttpClientSocket применяет все три.

title.en: Windows CNG becomes a certificate-store backend
title.fr: Windows CNG devient un backend de certificats
title.zh: Windows CNG 成为证书存储后端
title.ru: Windows CNG стал backend хранилища сертификатов

summary.en: A new Windows-only unit exposes store enumeration, KSP-backed signing, transient PFX loading and RSA envelope opening while keeping private material inside CNG.
summary.fr: Une nouvelle unit Windows expose l’énumération des stores, la signature KSP, le chargement PFX transitoire et l’ouverture d’enveloppes RSA sans extraire la clé privée.
summary.zh: 新的 Windows 专用 unit 提供 store 枚举、KSP 签名、临时 PFX 加载与 RSA envelope 解密，私钥始终留在 CNG。
summary.ru: Новый Windows-only unit предоставляет перечисление store, KSP-подпись, временную загрузку PFX и открытие RSA-envelope без извлечения private key.

title.en: PKCS#11 import, signing and lifetime are repaired as one sequence
title.fr: Import, signature et cycle de vie PKCS#11 sont réparés ensemble
title.zh: PKCS#11 导入、签名与生命周期作为一组修复
title.ru: Импорт, подпись и жизненный цикл PKCS#11 исправлены одной серией

summary.en: Hardware-token RSA opening, PSS and larger ECC signatures arrive alongside a catalog-level lock and fixes for background shutdown, import rollback, PIN role, object finalization and public-key extraction.
summary.fr: L’ouverture RSA sur token, PSS et les signatures ECC plus larges arrivent avec un verrou de catalogue et des correctifs de shutdown, rollback d’import, rôle PIN, finalisation et extraction de clé publique.
summary.zh: 硬件 token RSA 解密、PSS 与更大 ECC 签名同时加入 catalog 级锁，并修复后台关闭、导入回滚、PIN 角色、对象 finalization 与公钥提取。
summary.ru: RSA-open на hardware token, PSS и более крупные ECC-подписи дополнены catalog lock и исправлениями shutdown, rollback импорта, роли PIN, finalization и извлечения public key.

title.en: Memory, sockets and HTTP clients gain concrete safety fixes
title.fr: Mémoire, sockets et clients HTTP reçoivent des correctifs concrets
title.zh: 内存、socket 与 HTTP client 获得明确安全修复
title.ru: Память, сокеты и HTTP-клиенты получили конкретные исправления

summary.en: JSON logging no longer reads past invalid UTF-8 input, recv retry obeys its deadline, IOCP closes send FIN, reverse-proxy cookies are filtered and HTTP timeout phases are independently configurable.
summary.fr: Le log JSON ne lit plus après l’entrée UTF-8 invalide, recv respecte son échéance, IOCP envoie FIN, les cookies proxy sont filtrés et les phases de timeout HTTP sont configurables séparément.
summary.zh: JSON 日志不再越过无效 UTF-8 输入，recv 重试遵守 deadline，IOCP 关闭会发送 FIN，代理 cookie 被过滤，HTTP timeout 各阶段可独立配置。
summary.ru: JSON-лог больше не читает за invalid UTF-8, recv retry соблюдает deadline, IOCP close отправляет FIN, proxy cookies фильтруются, а HTTP timeouts настраиваются раздельно.

title.en: OpenSSL declarations are realigned with C ABIs
title.fr: Les déclarations OpenSSL sont réalignées sur les ABI C
title.zh: OpenSSL 声明重新对齐 C ABI
title.ru: Объявления OpenSSL выровнены с C ABI

summary.en: C long and unsigned-long widths, OpenSSL 3 option masks, error-queue codes and validity dates now use platform-correct declarations, especially on Win64 and 64-bit POSIX.
summary.fr: Les tailles C long/unsigned long, les masques OpenSSL 3, les codes d’erreur et les dates utilisent les déclarations correctes, surtout sur Win64 et POSIX 64-bit.
summary.zh: C long/unsigned long 宽度、OpenSSL 3 option mask、错误队列代码与有效期现在使用平台正确声明，尤其针对 Win64 与 64-bit POSIX。
summary.ru: Размеры C long/unsigned long, маски OpenSSL 3, error-queue codes и даты validity используют правильные объявления, особенно на Win64 и 64-bit POSIX.

order.why: Take the new Windows CNG unit, certificate backend, transient PFX factory, GPF repair and RSA-open support as one completed sequence.
Take the PKCS#11 locking, background lifetime, signing, import, object-finalization and key-extraction repairs together.
Take all OpenSSL declaration updates together because later commits refine platform widths and error-code types.
Take the recv retry repair with its deadline cleanup.
Take the three-phase HTTP timeout API with the REST client integration.

upgrade_advice.en: Land on build 2.4.17268. Upgrade promptly if production logs untrusted or binary text, uses blocking/TLS sockets, Windows IOCP, reverse-proxied REST authentication, OpenSSL, Windows CNG or PKCS#11. Add mormot.crypt.win to affected uses clauses. Audit direct TPkcs11 sharing: it is no longer internally locked, so use TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock around catalog operations. Exercise hardware-token import, PSS/ECC signing, shutdown during background discovery, RSA Open and distinct HTTP timeout paths. The raw payload has no superseded_by markers, so no avoid window is asserted.
upgrade_advice.fr: Visez la build 2.4.17268. Mettez à niveau si la production logue du texte non fiable ou binaire, utilise des sockets blocking/TLS, IOCP Windows, l’auth REST derrière proxy, OpenSSL, Windows CNG ou PKCS#11. Ajoutez mormot.crypt.win aux uses concernés. Auditez le partage direct de TPkcs11 : il n’est plus verrouillé en interne, donc utilisez TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock. Testez import de token, signatures PSS/ECC, shutdown pendant la découverte, RSA Open et les trois timeouts HTTP. Aucun superseded_by n’étaye une plage à éviter.
upgrade_advice.zh: 请采用 build 2.4.17268。若生产环境记录不可信或二进制文本，或使用 blocking/TLS socket、Windows IOCP、反向代理后的 REST 认证、OpenSSL、Windows CNG 或 PKCS#11，应尽快升级。为受影响的 uses 加入 mormot.crypt.win。审查直接共享 TPkcs11 的代码：它不再内部加锁，请用 TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock 保护 catalog 操作。测试硬件 token 导入、PSS/ECC 签名、后台发现期间关闭、RSA Open 与三类 HTTP timeout。原始 payload 没有 superseded_by，因此不声明避开区间。
upgrade_advice.ru: Переходите на build 2.4.17268. Срочно обновитесь, если production логирует недоверенный или binary text, использует blocking/TLS sockets, Windows IOCP, REST auth за proxy, OpenSSL, Windows CNG или PKCS#11. Добавьте mormot.crypt.win в нужные uses. Проверьте прямое совместное использование TPkcs11: внутренней блокировки больше нет, применяйте TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock. Протестируйте import в token, PSS/ECC signatures, shutdown во время discovery, RSA Open и три HTTP timeout. superseded_by отсутствует, поэтому avoid window не заявляется.

notes.en: Reviewed all 56 non-merge commits from build 2.4.17209 through 2.4.17268: 2,694 additions and 1,378 deletions after excluding version bookkeeping. Four merge commits were excluded. No commit carries superseded_by metadata; ordering reflects directly inspected same-unit follow-ups and does not create an avoid range.
notes.fr: Les 56 commits non-merge de 2.4.17209 à 2.4.17268 ont été examinés : 2 694 ajouts et 1 378 suppressions hors version bookkeeping. Quatre merges sont exclus. Aucun superseded_by ; l’ordre vient des follow-ups inspectés et ne crée pas de plage à éviter.
notes.zh: 已审查 build 2.4.17209 至 2.4.17268 的全部 56 个 non-merge commit：排除版本 bookkeeping 后新增 2,694 行、删除 1,378 行。另有 4 个 merge commit 被排除。没有 superseded_by；顺序来自直接检查的同 unit follow-up，不声明避开区间。
notes.ru: Проверены все 56 non-merge commits от 2.4.17209 до 2.4.17268: 2 694 добавления и 1 378 удалений без version bookkeeping. Четыре merge commits исключены. superseded_by отсутствует; порядок основан на проверенных follow-ups и не задаёт avoid range.

headline.en: Windows CryptoAPI AES classes move into a dedicated unit
headline.fr: Les classes AES CryptoAPI passent dans une unit dédiée
headline.zh: Windows CryptoAPI AES 类迁移到独立 unit
headline.ru: Классы Windows CryptoAPI AES перенесены в отдельный unit

what_changed.en: TAesAbstractApi, TAesEcbApi, TAesCbcApi, TAesCfbApi and TAesOfbApi move from mormot.crypt.core into the new mormot.crypt.win unit, which is added to the Lazarus package.
what_changed.fr: TAesAbstractApi, TAesEcbApi, TAesCbcApi, TAesCfbApi et TAesOfbApi quittent mormot.crypt.core pour la nouvelle unit mormot.crypt.win, ajoutée au package Lazarus.
what_changed.zh: TAesAbstractApi、TAesEcbApi、TAesCbcApi、TAesCfbApi 与 TAesOfbApi 从 mormot.crypt.core 移至新的 mormot.crypt.win，并加入 Lazarus package。
what_changed.ru: TAesAbstractApi, TAesEcbApi, TAesCbcApi, TAesCfbApi и TAesOfbApi перенесены из mormot.crypt.core в новый unit mormot.crypt.win, добавленный в Lazarus package.

impact.en: Projects that name these public types without already importing mormot.crypt.win stop compiling; AES behavior itself is unchanged. Non-Windows code can include the new do-nothing unit.
impact.fr: Les projets qui nomment ces types sans importer mormot.crypt.win ne compilent plus ; le comportement AES ne change pas. La unit reste neutre hors Windows.
impact.zh: 直接引用这些公开类型且未导入 mormot.crypt.win 的项目将无法编译；AES 行为不变。非 Windows 目标可安全包含该空操作 unit。
impact.ru: Проекты, использующие эти публичные типы без mormot.crypt.win, перестанут компилироваться; поведение AES не меняется. Вне Windows unit ничего не делает.

action_detail.en: Grep for TAesAbstractApi, TAesEcbApi, TAesCbcApi, TAesCfbApi and TAesOfbApi, then add mormot.crypt.win to those uses clauses.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez ces cinq classes TAes*Api et ajoutez mormot.crypt.win aux uses concernés.
action_detail.zh: 搜索这五个 TAes*Api 类，并在相应 uses 中加入 mormot.crypt.win。
action_detail.ru: Найдите пять классов TAes*Api и добавьте mormot.crypt.win в соответствующие uses.

note.en: The new unit now owns the public Windows CryptoAPI AES classes.
note.fr: La nouvelle unit contient les classes AES CryptoAPI publiques.
note.zh: 新 unit 现承载公开 Windows CryptoAPI AES 类。
note.ru: Новый unit теперь содержит публичные CryptoAPI AES-классы.

headline.en: Windows certificate stores expose CNG-backed identities
headline.fr: Les stores Windows exposent les identités adossées à CNG
headline.zh: Windows 证书存储公开 CNG 支持的 identity
headline.ru: Windows certificate stores предоставляют CNG-backed identities

what_changed.en: mormot.crypt.win adds TWinCertStoreLocations, ICryptCertCng, TCryptCertAlgoCng and TCryptCertCng to enumerate CurrentUser/LocalMachine stores, find certificates and sign through CNG KSP keys.
what_changed.fr: mormot.crypt.win ajoute TWinCertStoreLocations, ICryptCertCng, TCryptCertAlgoCng et TCryptCertCng pour énumérer les stores, rechercher les certificats et signer via les clés KSP CNG.
what_changed.zh: mormot.crypt.win 新增 TWinCertStoreLocations、ICryptCertCng、TCryptCertAlgoCng 与 TCryptCertCng，用于枚举 CurrentUser/LocalMachine store、查找证书并通过 CNG KSP 签名。
what_changed.ru: mormot.crypt.win добавляет TWinCertStoreLocations, ICryptCertCng, TCryptCertAlgoCng и TCryptCertCng для перечисления store, поиска сертификатов и подписи через CNG KSP.

impact.en: Windows backends can use system-store, smart-card and hardware-KSP identities without exporting private keys. Delphi and FPC builds on other platforms are unaffected.
impact.fr: Les backends Windows peuvent employer des identités de store, carte ou KSP sans exporter les clés privées. Les autres plateformes ne changent pas.
impact.zh: Windows 后端可使用系统 store、smart card 与硬件 KSP identity，无需导出私钥。其他平台的 Delphi/FPC 不受影响。
impact.ru: Windows-backend может использовать system-store, smart-card и hardware-KSP identities без экспорта private key. Другие платформы не затронуты.

action_detail.en: Evaluate TCryptCertAlgoCng.Cert, Find or FindOne where Windows services currently load exportable PFX files.
action_detail.fr: Évaluez TCryptCertAlgoCng.Cert, Find ou FindOne là où les services Windows chargent des PFX exportables.
action_detail.zh: 对于当前加载可导出 PFX 的 Windows 服务，请评估 TCryptCertAlgoCng.Cert、Find 或 FindOne。
action_detail.ru: Рассмотрите TCryptCertAlgoCng.Cert, Find или FindOne там, где Windows services загружают экспортируемые PFX.

headline.en: Unsupported certificate factories return nil instead of dereferencing it
headline.fr: Les factories non prises en charge renvoient nil sans le déréférencer
headline.zh: 不支持的证书 factory 返回 nil 且不再解引用
headline.ru: Неподдерживаемые certificate factories возвращают nil без разыменования

what_changed.en: TCryptCertAlgo.New and FromHandle become virtual nil-returning defaults, and Load, Generate, CreateSelfSignedCsr and GenerateFromCsr now test the returned interface before invoking it. CNG and PKCS#11 delete duplicate weak overrides.
what_changed.fr: TCryptCertAlgo.New et FromHandle deviennent des defaults virtuels renvoyant nil ; Load, Generate, CreateSelfSignedCsr et GenerateFromCsr vérifient l’interface avant appel. CNG et PKCS#11 retirent leurs overrides redondants.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertAlgo.New 与 FromHandle 改为默认返回 nil 的 virtual 方法，Load、Generate、CreateSelfSignedCsr 与 GenerateFromCsr 在调用前检查接口。CNG 与 PKCS#11 删除重复 override。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertAlgo.New и FromHandle стали virtual defaults с nil; Load, Generate, CreateSelfSignedCsr и GenerateFromCsr проверяют интерфейс перед вызовом. CNG и PKCS#11 удаляют лишние overrides.

impact.en: Calling generic factory methods on catalog-style algorithms no longer risks an access violation. Supported certificate implementations retain their prior factories.
impact.fr: Les méthodes génériques sur les algorithmes de catalogue ne risquent plus un access violation. Les implémentations prises en charge restent inchangées.
impact.zh: 对 catalog 型算法调用通用 factory 不再可能触发 access violation。受支持的证书实现保持原有 factory。
impact.ru: Вызов generic factory у catalog-style алгоритмов больше не грозит access violation. Поддерживаемые реализации сохраняют прежние factories.

action_detail.en: Upgrade if code calls TCryptCertAlgo.Load, Generate or GenerateFromCsr through CNG or PKCS#11 providers.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau si le code appelle Load, Generate ou GenerateFromCsr via CNG ou PKCS#11.
action_detail.zh: 若代码通过 CNG 或 PKCS#11 provider 调用 Load、Generate 或 GenerateFromCsr，请升级。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь, если код вызывает Load, Generate или GenerateFromCsr через CNG/PKCS#11.

headline.en: Windows certificate provider metadata gets a focused wrapper
headline.fr: Les métadonnées du provider certificat Windows ont un wrapper dédié
headline.zh: Windows 证书 provider 元数据新增专用 wrapper
headline.ru: Метаданные Windows certificate provider получили отдельный wrapper

what_changed.en: mormot.lib.sspi adds TWinCertKeyProviderInfo and WinCertCtxtKeyProvider to decode CERT_KEY_PROV_INFO_PROP_ID; CNG store loading consumes this narrower record instead of the full TWinCertInfo.
what_changed.fr: mormot.lib.sspi ajoute TWinCertKeyProviderInfo et WinCertCtxtKeyProvider pour décoder CERT_KEY_PROV_INFO_PROP_ID ; CNG utilise ce record ciblé plutôt que TWinCertInfo complet.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.sspi 新增 TWinCertKeyProviderInfo 与 WinCertCtxtKeyProvider 来解码 CERT_KEY_PROV_INFO_PROP_ID；CNG store 加载改用该精简 record。
what_changed.ru: mormot.lib.sspi добавляет TWinCertKeyProviderInfo и WinCertCtxtKeyProvider для CERT_KEY_PROV_INFO_PROP_ID; CNG использует узкий record вместо полного TWinCertInfo.

impact.en: Windows callers gain a cheaper provider-information query; existing TWinCertInfo decoding remains available and application code need not change.
impact.fr: Les appelants Windows gagnent une requête provider plus ciblée ; TWinCertInfo reste disponible et aucun changement applicatif n’est requis.
impact.zh: Windows 调用方获得更轻量的 provider 信息查询；现有 TWinCertInfo 解码仍可用，应用代码无需更改。
impact.ru: Windows-код получает более дешёвый provider query; TWinCertInfo остаётся доступен, изменений приложения не требуется.

headline.en: CNG key acquisition options replace separate booleans
headline.fr: Les options d’acquisition CNG remplacent plusieurs booléens
headline.zh: CNG key 获取选项取代多个 boolean
headline.ru: Опции получения CNG key заменили отдельные boolean

what_changed.en: TWinCertCngKeyOption and TWinCertCngKeyOptions represent silent, key-comparison and cache choices; TWinCertCngKey.Init and TCryptCertCng use the set.
what_changed.fr: TWinCertCngKeyOption et TWinCertCngKeyOptions représentent silent, comparaison et cache ; TWinCertCngKey.Init et TCryptCertCng utilisent cet ensemble.
what_changed.zh: TWinCertCngKeyOption 与 TWinCertCngKeyOptions 表示 silent、key comparison 与 cache 选项；TWinCertCngKey.Init 和 TCryptCertCng 改用该 set。
what_changed.ru: TWinCertCngKeyOption и TWinCertCngKeyOptions задают silent, сравнение ключа и cache; TWinCertCngKey.Init и TCryptCertCng используют set.

impact.en: New CNG code can combine key-acquisition behavior explicitly. This API was introduced within the same edition, so no established call site is displaced.
impact.fr: Le nouveau code CNG combine explicitement les comportements d’acquisition. L’API est nouvelle dans cette même édition.
impact.zh: 新的 CNG 代码可显式组合 key 获取行为。该 API 在同一期内引入，不影响既有调用。
impact.ru: Новый CNG-код явно комбинирует режимы получения ключа. API появился в этом же выпуске, существующих вызовов нет.

headline.en: ZIP conditionals avoid misleading FPC compiler hints
headline.fr: Les conditionnels ZIP évitent des hints FPC trompeurs
headline.zh: ZIP 条件编译避免误导性的 FPC hint
headline.ru: Условия ZIP устраняют ложные подсказки FPC

what_changed.en: mormot.core.zip rearranges conditional declarations and assignments around FPC-only symbols to silence incorrect compiler hints without changing executable logic.
what_changed.fr: mormot.core.zip réorganise les déclarations conditionnelles FPC pour supprimer des hints incorrects sans changer la logique exécutée.
what_changed.zh: mormot.core.zip 调整 FPC 专用符号的条件声明与赋值，以消除错误 compiler hint，不改变执行逻辑。
what_changed.ru: mormot.core.zip переставляет условные объявления FPC-only символов, убирая ложные compiler hints без изменения логики.

impact.en: FPC builds are quieter; Delphi/FPC backend behavior and public APIs are unchanged.
impact.fr: Les builds FPC sont plus propres ; comportement et API restent inchangés.
impact.zh: FPC 构建更安静；Delphi/FPC 后端行为与公开 API 不变。
impact.ru: Сборки FPC стали чище; поведение backend и public API не меняются.

headline.en: GenerateFromCsr delegates to the created certificate instead of recursing
headline.fr: GenerateFromCsr délègue au certificat créé au lieu de récursiver
headline.zh: GenerateFromCsr 改为委托新证书而非递归自身
headline.ru: GenerateFromCsr делегирует созданному сертификату вместо рекурсии

what_changed.en: TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr now calls result.GenerateFromCsr on the New instance instead of recursively invoking the factory method. Comments also clarify void factories and the CNG subclass.
what_changed.fr: TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr appelle maintenant result.GenerateFromCsr sur l’instance New au lieu de rappeler récursivement la factory. Les commentaires précisent aussi les factories vides et CNG.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr 现在对 New 返回的实例调用 result.GenerateFromCsr，而不再递归调用 factory 自身；注释同时澄清 void factory 与 CNG 子类。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr теперь вызывает result.GenerateFromCsr у экземпляра New вместо рекурсивного вызова factory; комментарии уточняют void factories и CNG.

impact.en: CSR-to-certificate generation through the base factory no longer recurses indefinitely or overflows the stack. Existing successful overrides keep their behavior.
impact.fr: La génération certificat depuis CSR via la factory de base ne récursive plus indéfiniment. Les overrides valides gardent leur comportement.
impact.zh: 通过基础 factory 从 CSR 生成证书不再无限递归或导致 stack overflow；现有有效 override 行为不变。
impact.ru: Генерация сертификата из CSR через базовую factory больше не уходит в бесконечную рекурсию/stack overflow. Рабочие overrides не меняются.

action_detail.en: Upgrade if a backend invokes TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr through a concrete factory.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau si un backend appelle TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr via une factory concrète.
action_detail.zh: 若后端通过具体 factory 调用 TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr，请升级。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь, если backend вызывает TCryptCertAlgo.GenerateFromCsr через конкретную factory.

headline.en: OpenSSL certificate validity preserves negative start offsets
headline.fr: La validité OpenSSL conserve les offsets de début négatifs
headline.zh: OpenSSL 证书有效期保留负起始偏移
headline.ru: OpenSSL validity сохраняет отрицательный start offset

what_changed.en: X509.SetValidity stops forcing negative ValidDays to zero because supported X509_gmtime_adj versions accept negative offsets.
what_changed.fr: X509.SetValidity ne force plus ValidDays négatif à zéro car les versions prises en charge de X509_gmtime_adj acceptent ces offsets.
what_changed.zh: X509.SetValidity 不再把负 ValidDays 强制为零，因为受支持的 X509_gmtime_adj 接受负偏移。
what_changed.ru: X509.SetValidity больше не превращает отрицательный ValidDays в ноль: поддерживаемые X509_gmtime_adj принимают такой offset.

impact.en: Generated OpenSSL certificates can again start before the current time, preserving the intended clock-skew allowance.
impact.fr: Les certificats OpenSSL peuvent à nouveau commencer avant l’heure courante et préserver la tolérance de clock skew.
impact.zh: 生成的 OpenSSL 证书可再次在当前时间之前生效，保留预期 clock-skew 容忍。
impact.ru: OpenSSL certificates снова могут начинаться до текущего времени, сохраняя допуск clock skew.

action_detail.en: Retest generated certificate notBefore values if ValidDays is negative.
action_detail.fr: Retestez notBefore si ValidDays est négatif.
action_detail.zh: 若 ValidDays 为负，请重新测试生成证书的 notBefore。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте notBefore, если ValidDays отрицателен.

headline.en: OpenSSL C long declarations use platform-sized Pascal types
headline.fr: Les C long OpenSSL utilisent des types Pascal adaptés à la plateforme
headline.zh: OpenSSL C long 声明改用平台匹配的 Pascal 类型
headline.ru: Объявления OpenSSL C long используют платформенные Pascal-типы

what_changed.en: Dozens of mormot.lib.openssl11 declarations and wrapper returns change from integer/cardinal to clong or PtrInt for C long parameters, lengths, versions, modes and callbacks.
what_changed.fr: Des dizaines de déclarations et retours mormot.lib.openssl11 passent de integer/cardinal à clong ou PtrInt pour les C long, tailles, versions, modes et callbacks.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.openssl11 的数十个声明与 wrapper 返回值从 integer/cardinal 改为 clong 或 PtrInt，以匹配 C long 参数、长度、版本、mode 与 callback。
what_changed.ru: Десятки declarations и wrapper returns в mormot.lib.openssl11 переведены с integer/cardinal на clong или PtrInt для C long, lengths, versions, modes и callbacks.

impact.en: ABI mismatches on 64-bit POSIX are removed. Low-level callers assigning these public results to 32-bit variables may need an explicit conversion.
impact.fr: Les incompatibilités ABI POSIX 64-bit disparaissent. Les appelants bas niveau stockant les résultats en 32-bit peuvent nécessiter une conversion.
impact.zh: 修复 64-bit POSIX ABI 不匹配。把这些公开返回值存入 32-bit 变量的低层调用方可能需要显式转换。
impact.ru: Устранены ABI mismatch на 64-bit POSIX. Низкоуровневым вызовам, сохраняющим результаты в 32-bit, может понадобиться явное преобразование.

action_detail.en: Rebuild all OpenSSL consumers on 64-bit POSIX and inspect compile errors around changed wrapper result types.
action_detail.fr: Recompilez les consommateurs OpenSSL POSIX 64-bit et examinez les erreurs sur les types de retour modifiés.
action_detail.zh: 在 64-bit POSIX 上重建所有 OpenSSL 使用方，并检查 wrapper 返回类型变化引起的编译错误。
action_detail.ru: Пересоберите OpenSSL consumers на 64-bit POSIX и проверьте ошибки типов изменённых wrapper results.

headline.en: A second OpenSSL ABI pass fixes control and mode widths
headline.fr: Un second passage OpenSSL corrige les tailles de control et mode
headline.zh: 第二轮 OpenSSL ABI 修正 control 与 mode 宽度
headline.ru: Второй проход OpenSSL ABI исправляет ширину control и mode

what_changed.en: The Windows compatibility types move before OpenSSL declarations, and session-cache, mode, extra-chain and callback wrappers consistently use clong; Windows timeval fields follow clong.
what_changed.fr: Les types Windows précèdent les déclarations OpenSSL, et les wrappers session-cache, mode, extra-chain et callback utilisent clong de façon cohérente ; timeval suit clong.
what_changed.zh: Windows 兼容类型移到 OpenSSL 声明之前，session-cache、mode、extra-chain 与 callback wrapper 统一使用 clong；Windows timeval 字段也采用 clong。
what_changed.ru: Windows compatibility types перенесены перед OpenSSL declarations, а session-cache, mode, extra-chain и callback wrappers последовательно используют clong; timeval также следует clong.

impact.en: OpenSSL control wrappers now match C calling conventions across Delphi/FPC targets; ordinary high-level TLS code is source-compatible.
impact.fr: Les wrappers OpenSSL correspondent désormais aux conventions C sur Delphi/FPC ; le code TLS haut niveau reste compatible.
impact.zh: OpenSSL control wrapper 现匹配各 Delphi/FPC 目标的 C 调用约定；高层 TLS 代码保持源兼容。
impact.ru: OpenSSL control wrappers теперь соответствуют C ABI на Delphi/FPC; высокоуровневый TLS-код совместим.

action_detail.en: Take this commit together with the surrounding OpenSSL declaration fixes.
action_detail.fr: Prenez ce commit avec les autres corrections de déclarations OpenSSL.
action_detail.zh: 请将此 commit 与相邻 OpenSSL 声明修复一起采用。
action_detail.ru: Берите commit вместе с соседними исправлениями OpenSSL declarations.

headline.en: A Windows wrapper imports PFX data with wiped passwords
headline.fr: Un wrapper Windows importe les PFX en effaçant les mots de passe
headline.zh: Windows wrapper 导入 PFX 并擦除密码缓冲区
headline.ru: Windows wrapper импортирует PFX и очищает пароль

what_changed.en: mormot.lib.sspi adds WinCertStoreImportPfx, converts SpiUtf8 to UTF-16, invokes PFXImportCertStore, captures errors and wipes the temporary password buffer.
what_changed.fr: mormot.lib.sspi ajoute WinCertStoreImportPfx, convertit SpiUtf8 en UTF-16, appelle PFXImportCertStore, capture les erreurs et efface le buffer du mot de passe.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.sspi 新增 WinCertStoreImportPfx，将 SpiUtf8 转成 UTF-16，调用 PFXImportCertStore，捕获错误并擦除临时密码缓冲。
what_changed.ru: mormot.lib.sspi добавляет WinCertStoreImportPfx: преобразует SpiUtf8 в UTF-16, вызывает PFXImportCertStore, сохраняет ошибки и очищает временный пароль.

impact.en: Windows PFX consumers gain one error-code-based import path with explicit password cleanup. Existing direct API calls remain available.
impact.fr: Les consommateurs PFX Windows gagnent un chemin d’import avec code d’erreur et effacement explicite du mot de passe.
impact.zh: Windows PFX 使用方获得基于错误码且显式清理密码的统一导入路径。现有直接 API 仍可用。
impact.ru: Windows PFX consumers получают единый import path с error code и очисткой пароля. Прямой API остаётся доступен.

headline.en: Windows C long stays 32-bit on Win64
headline.fr: Le C long Windows reste 32-bit sous Win64
headline.zh: Windows C long 在 Win64 上保持 32-bit
headline.ru: Windows C long остаётся 32-bit на Win64

what_changed.en: The Windows clong alias changes from PtrInt to integer and timeval fields use clong, correcting the LLP64 ABI used by OpenSSL on Win64.
what_changed.fr: L’alias Windows clong passe de PtrInt à integer et timeval utilise clong, conformément à l’ABI LLP64 OpenSSL sous Win64.
what_changed.zh: Windows clong 别名从 PtrInt 改为 integer，timeval 字段使用 clong，修正 Win64 OpenSSL 的 LLP64 ABI。
what_changed.ru: Windows alias clong изменён с PtrInt на integer, поля timeval используют clong, что исправляет LLP64 ABI OpenSSL на Win64.

impact.en: Win64 OpenSSL calls no longer pass or receive eight-byte values where the C ABI expects four bytes.
impact.fr: Les appels OpenSSL Win64 n’échangent plus huit octets là où l’ABI C en attend quatre.
impact.zh: Win64 OpenSSL 调用不再在 C ABI 期望四字节时传递或接收八字节值。
impact.ru: Вызовы OpenSSL на Win64 больше не передают восемь байт там, где C ABI ожидает четыре.

action_detail.en: Rebuild and retest Win64 OpenSSL certificate and TLS paths.
action_detail.fr: Recompilez et retestez les chemins certificat et TLS OpenSSL Win64.
action_detail.zh: 重建并重新测试 Win64 OpenSSL 证书与 TLS 路径。
action_detail.ru: Пересоберите и протестируйте certificate/TLS paths OpenSSL на Win64.

headline.en: SChannel PFX loading reuses the secure Windows importer
headline.fr: Le chargement PFX SChannel réutilise l’importeur Windows sécurisé
headline.zh: SChannel PFX 加载复用安全 Windows importer
headline.ru: SChannel PFX loading использует безопасный Windows importer

what_changed.en: TSChannelServerContext.LoadCertificate replaces inline PFXImportCertStore and password conversion with WinCertStoreImportPfx, then wipes the UTF-8 password and checks the returned error.
what_changed.fr: TSChannelServerContext.LoadCertificate remplace son code PFXImportCertStore par WinCertStoreImportPfx, efface le mot de passe UTF-8 et vérifie l’erreur.
what_changed.zh: TSChannelServerContext.LoadCertificate 用 WinCertStoreImportPfx 取代内联 PFXImportCertStore 与密码转换，然后擦除 UTF-8 密码并检查错误。
what_changed.ru: TSChannelServerContext.LoadCertificate заменяет inline PFXImportCertStore на WinCertStoreImportPfx, очищает UTF-8 пароль и проверяет ошибку.

impact.en: SChannel server certificate loading keeps the same public behavior with centralized password cleanup and error handling.
impact.fr: Le chargement de certificat serveur SChannel conserve son comportement avec une gestion centralisée du mot de passe et des erreurs.
impact.zh: SChannel 服务器证书加载的公开行为不变，但密码清理与错误处理得到统一。
impact.ru: Публичное поведение загрузки SChannel certificate не меняется; очистка пароля и errors централизованы.

headline.en: CNG certificate construction tightens ownership and store metadata
headline.fr: La construction CNG précise ownership et métadonnées de store
headline.zh: CNG 证书构造收紧 ownership 与 store 元数据
headline.ru: Создание CNG certificate уточняет ownership и store metadata

what_changed.en: TCryptCertCng construction is reorganized around duplicated contexts, provider records and explicit key options; GetSystemStore reports whether the identity came from a system store.
what_changed.fr: La construction TCryptCertCng est réorganisée autour des contexts dupliqués, provider records et options de clé ; GetSystemStore indique l’origine system store.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertCng 构造围绕复制的 context、provider record 与显式 key option 重组；GetSystemStore 报告 identity 是否来自系统 store。
what_changed.ru: Создание TCryptCertCng переработано вокруг duplicated context, provider record и key options; GetSystemStore сообщает происхождение из system store.

impact.en: New CNG identities keep clearer ownership and metadata. This is an in-edition refinement of the newly introduced API.
impact.fr: Les nouvelles identités CNG ont un ownership et des métadonnées plus clairs. Il s’agit d’un raffinement de la nouvelle API.
impact.zh: 新的 CNG identity 获得更明确的 ownership 与元数据；这是对本期新 API 的完善。
impact.ru: Новые CNG identities имеют более ясные ownership и metadata; это уточнение API, появившегося в этом выпуске.

headline.en: REST authentication ignores unrelated reverse-proxy cookies
headline.fr: L’authentification REST ignore les cookies du reverse proxy
headline.zh: REST 认证忽略无关反向代理 cookie
headline.ru: REST-аутентификация игнорирует чужие reverse-proxy cookies

what_changed.en: TRestClientAuthentication.ClientGetSessionKey parses Set-Cookie only for HTTP-based schemes and searches all headers for the Model.Root cookie instead of consuming the first proxy cookie.
what_changed.fr: TRestClientAuthentication.ClientGetSessionKey ne lit Set-Cookie que pour les schémas HTTP et recherche le cookie Model.Root au lieu de prendre le premier cookie proxy.
what_changed.zh: TRestClientAuthentication.ClientGetSessionKey 仅对 HTTP-based scheme 解析 Set-Cookie，并在所有 header 中查找 Model.Root cookie，不再采用第一个代理 cookie。
what_changed.ru: TRestClientAuthentication.ClientGetSessionKey разбирает Set-Cookie только для HTTP-схем и ищет cookie Model.Root вместо первого proxy cookie.

impact.en: Signed-URI authentication behind proxies such as Azure App Proxy no longer derives a bogus session ID and fails subsequent requests with 403.
impact.fr: L’auth signed-URI derrière Azure App Proxy ne prend plus un faux session ID conduisant aux 403 suivants.
impact.zh: Azure App Proxy 等代理后的 signed-URI 认证不再使用错误 session ID，后续请求不会因此返回 403。
impact.ru: Signed-URI auth за Azure App Proxy больше не получает ложный session ID и не приводит к 403 на следующих запросах.

action_detail.en: Retest login and the first signed request behind any proxy that injects cookies.
action_detail.fr: Retestez le login et la première requête signée derrière tout proxy injectant des cookies.
action_detail.zh: 重新测试会注入 cookie 的代理后的登录与首次 signed request。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте login и первый signed request за proxy, добавляющим cookies.

headline.en: REST cookie lookup mirrors slash-to-underscore naming
headline.fr: La recherche de cookie REST reproduit le remplacement slash/underscore
headline.zh: REST cookie 查找匹配 slash 转 underscore 规则
headline.ru: REST cookie lookup повторяет замену slash на underscore

what_changed.en: ClientGetSessionKey normalizes Model.Root with StringReplaceChars('/', '_') before comparing cookie names, matching TRestUriContext.SetOutCookie.
what_changed.fr: ClientGetSessionKey normalise Model.Root via StringReplaceChars('/', '_') avant de comparer le cookie, comme TRestUriContext.SetOutCookie.
what_changed.zh: ClientGetSessionKey 在比较 cookie 名之前用 StringReplaceChars('/', '_') 规范化 Model.Root，与 TRestUriContext.SetOutCookie 一致。
what_changed.ru: ClientGetSessionKey нормализует Model.Root через StringReplaceChars('/', '_') перед сравнением cookie, как TRestUriContext.SetOutCookie.

impact.en: HTTP authentication works for roots such as api/v1 whose actual session cookie is api_v1.
impact.fr: L’auth HTTP fonctionne pour les roots comme api/v1 dont le cookie réel est api_v1.
impact.zh: 对于 api/v1 这类实际 cookie 名为 api_v1 的 root，HTTP 认证现可正常工作。
impact.ru: HTTP auth работает для root вроде api/v1, где реальный cookie называется api_v1.

action_detail.en: Retest HTTP authentication if Model.Root contains a slash.
action_detail.fr: Retestez l’auth HTTP si Model.Root contient un slash.
action_detail.zh: 若 Model.Root 含 slash，请重新测试 HTTP 认证。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте HTTP auth, если Model.Root содержит slash.

headline.en: Delphi Darwin stops linking an FPC-only C symbol
headline.fr: Delphi Darwin ne lie plus un symbole C réservé à FPC
headline.zh: Delphi Darwin 不再链接 FPC 专用 C symbol
headline.ru: Delphi Darwin больше не линкует FPC-only C symbol

what_changed.en: The mach_absolute_time external alias named GetTickCount64 is now declared only under FPC on Darwin, because Delphi never calls that entropy helper but still tried to resolve library c.
what_changed.fr: L’alias externe mach_absolute_time nommé GetTickCount64 n’est déclaré que sous FPC/Darwin ; Delphi ne l’utilise pas mais tentait de résoudre la bibliothèque c.
what_changed.zh: 名为 GetTickCount64 的 mach_absolute_time external alias 现在仅在 FPC Darwin 下声明；Delphi 不使用它却曾尝试解析 c library。
what_changed.ru: External alias mach_absolute_time с именем GetTickCount64 теперь объявляется только для FPC/Darwin; Delphi его не использует, но пытался разрешить library c.

impact.en: Delphi iOS and iOS Simulator links no longer fail with “ld: file not found: c”. FPC Darwin entropy behavior is unchanged.
impact.fr: Les liens Delphi iOS et Simulator ne tombent plus sur « ld: file not found: c ». FPC Darwin reste inchangé.
impact.zh: Delphi iOS 与 iOS Simulator 链接不再因 “ld: file not found: c” 失败；FPC Darwin entropy 行为不变。
impact.ru: Delphi iOS и Simulator больше не падают с «ld: file not found: c»; поведение FPC Darwin не меняется.

action_detail.en: Rebuild Delphi iOS device and simulator targets.
action_detail.fr: Recompilez les cibles Delphi iOS device et simulator.
action_detail.zh: 重建 Delphi iOS device 与 simulator 目标。
action_detail.ru: Пересоберите Delphi iOS device и simulator targets.

headline.en: SChannel Receive has an explicit fatal default
headline.fr: SChannel Receive a un défaut fatal explicite
headline.zh: SChannel Receive 设置明确 fatal 默认值
headline.ru: SChannel Receive получил явный fatal default

what_changed.en: TLS Channel Receive initializes result to nrFatalError and simplifies early exits around pending output and caught exceptions to avoid a Delphi 7 compiler warning.
what_changed.fr: TLS Channel Receive initialise result à nrFatalError et simplifie les sorties pour éviter un warning Delphi 7.
what_changed.zh: TLS Channel Receive 将 result 初始化为 nrFatalError，并简化 pending output 与异常捕获的 early exit，以避免 Delphi 7 warning。
what_changed.ru: TLS Channel Receive инициализирует result как nrFatalError и упрощает early exits, устраняя warning Delphi 7.

impact.en: Return behavior stays fatal on those unsupported/error paths; Delphi 7 builds stop warning about an uninitialized result.
impact.fr: Le comportement reste fatal sur ces chemins ; Delphi 7 ne signale plus un résultat non initialisé.
impact.zh: 这些不支持或错误路径仍返回 fatal；Delphi 7 不再警告 result 未初始化。
impact.ru: Поведение на этих error paths остаётся fatal; Delphi 7 больше не предупреждает о неинициализированном result.

headline.en: CNG can load a transient identity from PKCS#12
headline.fr: CNG peut charger une identité PKCS#12 transitoire
headline.zh: CNG 可从 PKCS#12 加载临时 identity
headline.ru: CNG загружает временную identity из PKCS#12

what_changed.en: An initial TCryptCertAlgoCng.LoadPkcs12 imports PFX data with PKCS12_NO_PERSIST_KEY, locates a certificate with an accessible CNG key and creates an ICryptCertCng with cached silent key access.
what_changed.fr: Un premier TCryptCertAlgoCng.LoadPkcs12 importe le PFX avec PKCS12_NO_PERSIST_KEY, trouve une clé CNG accessible et crée un ICryptCertCng en mode cached/silent.
what_changed.zh: 初版 TCryptCertAlgoCng.LoadPkcs12 以 PKCS12_NO_PERSIST_KEY 导入 PFX，查找可访问 CNG key 的证书，并创建 cached/silent ICryptCertCng。
what_changed.ru: Первый TCryptCertAlgoCng.LoadPkcs12 импортирует PFX с PKCS12_NO_PERSIST_KEY, находит доступный CNG key и создаёт cached/silent ICryptCertCng.

impact.en: Windows can use a PFX identity without persisting its private key. A later commit in this edition moves the final factory to TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12.
impact.fr: Windows peut utiliser une identité PFX sans persister sa clé. Un commit suivant déplace la factory finale vers TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12.
impact.zh: Windows 可使用 PFX identity 而不持久化私钥。本期后续 commit 将最终 factory 移至 TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12。
impact.ru: Windows может использовать PFX identity без сохранения private key. Поздний commit переносит финальную factory в TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12.

headline.en: IOCP AcceptEx sockets inherit the listener before shutdown
headline.fr: Les sockets IOCP AcceptEx héritent du listener avant shutdown
headline.zh: IOCP AcceptEx socket 在 shutdown 前继承 listener context
headline.ru: IOCP AcceptEx sockets наследуют listener context перед shutdown

what_changed.en: GetNextAccept sets SO_UPDATE_ACCEPT_CONTEXT with the listening socket before releasing accept state, logging a warning if setsockopt fails.
what_changed.fr: GetNextAccept applique SO_UPDATE_ACCEPT_CONTEXT avec le socket d’écoute avant de libérer l’état accept et logue un warning en cas d’échec.
what_changed.zh: GetNextAccept 在释放 accept state 前用监听 socket 设置 SO_UPDATE_ACCEPT_CONTEXT，setsockopt 失败时记录 warning。
what_changed.ru: GetNextAccept устанавливает SO_UPDATE_ACCEPT_CONTEXT с listening socket до освобождения accept state и логирует warning при ошибке.

impact.en: Server-side IOCP closes can call shutdown successfully and send FIN instead of failing with WSAENOTCONN and leaving clients waiting.
impact.fr: Les fermetures IOCP serveur peuvent envoyer FIN au lieu d’échouer avec WSAENOTCONN et laisser le client attendre.
impact.zh: 服务器端 IOCP 关闭可成功调用 shutdown 并发送 FIN，不再因 WSAENOTCONN 失败而让 client 等待。
impact.ru: Server-side IOCP close теперь успешно вызывает shutdown и отправляет FIN вместо WSAENOTCONN и зависшего клиента.

action_detail.en: Retest graceful server closes and client EOF detection on Windows IOCP.
action_detail.fr: Retestez les fermetures serveur et la détection EOF client sous Windows IOCP.
action_detail.zh: 重新测试 Windows IOCP 的服务器 graceful close 与 client EOF 检测。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте graceful close и client EOF на Windows IOCP.

headline.en: Socket receive retries obey the configured timeout
headline.fr: Les retries de réception respectent le timeout configuré
headline.zh: Socket receive 重试遵守配置 timeout
headline.ru: Socket receive retries соблюдают заданный timeout

what_changed.en: TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv keeps nrRetry through RecvPending and WaitFor, measures elapsed time and passes only the remaining TimeOut instead of converting retry to nrOk and looping on recv indefinitely.
what_changed.fr: TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv conserve nrRetry jusqu’à RecvPending/WaitFor, mesure le temps écoulé et ne passe que le TimeOut restant au lieu de boucler indéfiniment sur recv.
what_changed.zh: TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv 保留 nrRetry 状态直到 RecvPending/WaitFor，计算已用时间并仅传递剩余 TimeOut，不再把 retry 改为 nrOk 后无限 recv。
what_changed.ru: TCrtSocket.TrySockRecv сохраняет nrRetry до RecvPending/WaitFor, учитывает elapsed time и передаёт оставшийся TimeOut вместо бесконечного recv loop.

impact.en: Blocking or TLS reads that repeatedly return retry can no longer hang past the caller’s timeout budget.
impact.fr: Les lectures blocking ou TLS qui renvoient retry ne peuvent plus dépasser indéfiniment le timeout appelant.
impact.zh: 反复返回 retry 的 blocking 或 TLS read 不再能无限超过调用方 timeout。
impact.ru: Blocking/TLS reads с повторным retry больше не зависают сверх timeout caller.

action_detail.en: Test idle, partial and TLS-renegotiation reads at the configured boundary.
action_detail.fr: Testez les lectures idle, partielles et de renégociation TLS à la limite du timeout.
action_detail.zh: 在配置边界测试 idle、partial 与 TLS renegotiation read。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте idle, partial и TLS-renegotiation reads на границе timeout.

headline.en: CNG distinguishes store identities from transient PFX identities
headline.fr: CNG distingue les identités de store des identités PFX transitoires
headline.zh: CNG 区分 store identity 与临时 PFX identity
headline.ru: CNG различает store identities и временные PFX identities

what_changed.en: TCryptCertCng separates context initialization from store metadata and changes ICryptCertCng.GetSystemStore to return a boolean plus store and location outputs.
what_changed.fr: TCryptCertCng sépare l’initialisation du context des métadonnées de store et GetSystemStore renvoie un booléen avec store et location.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertCng 将 context 初始化与 store 元数据分离，并让 ICryptCertCng.GetSystemStore 返回 boolean 以及 store/location 输出。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertCng разделяет инициализацию context и store metadata; GetSystemStore возвращает boolean плюс store/location outputs.

impact.en: Callers can reliably tell whether a CNG certificate came from a persistent Windows store or an in-memory PFX.
impact.fr: Les appelants distinguent clairement un certificat CNG persistant d’un PFX en mémoire.
impact.zh: 调用方可可靠判断 CNG 证书来自持久 Windows store 还是内存 PFX。
impact.ru: Вызывающий код надёжно отличает CNG certificate из Windows store от in-memory PFX.

headline.en: Transient PFX loading becomes a CNG certificate class factory
headline.fr: Le chargement PFX devient une factory de classe CNG
headline.zh: 临时 PFX 加载改为 CNG 证书 class factory
headline.ru: Загрузка временного PFX стала class factory CNG certificate

what_changed.en: LoadPkcs12 moves from TCryptCertAlgoCng to the class function TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12, accepts an optional log class and constructs a transient identity without a catalog owner.
what_changed.fr: LoadPkcs12 passe de TCryptCertAlgoCng à la class function TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12, accepte un log optionnel et crée une identité sans catalogue.
what_changed.zh: LoadPkcs12 从 TCryptCertAlgoCng 移至 class function TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12，接受可选 log class，并创建无 catalog owner 的临时 identity。
what_changed.ru: LoadPkcs12 перенесён из TCryptCertAlgoCng в class function TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12, принимает optional log class и создаёт identity без catalog owner.

impact.en: PFX loading no longer requires enumerating or retaining a Windows store catalog. Anyone who used the briefly introduced algorithm method must call the class factory.
impact.fr: Le chargement PFX ne nécessite plus de catalogue. Les utilisateurs de la méthode intermédiaire doivent appeler la class factory.
impact.zh: PFX 加载不再需要枚举或保留 Windows store catalog；使用本期早期 algorithm method 的代码需改调 class factory。
impact.ru: PFX loading больше не требует catalog. Код, использовавший промежуточный algorithm method, должен вызвать class factory.

action_detail.en: Use TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12(Pfx, Password, LogClass) for transient identities.
action_detail.fr: Utilisez TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12(Pfx, Password, LogClass).
action_detail.zh: 临时 identity 请使用 TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12(Pfx, Password, LogClass)。
action_detail.ru: Для временных identities используйте TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12(Pfx, Password, LogClass).

headline.en: Transient CNG certificates no longer dereference a missing owner
headline.fr: Les certificats CNG transitoires ne déréférencent plus un owner absent
headline.zh: 临时 CNG 证书不再解引用缺失 owner
headline.ru: Временные CNG certificates больше не разыменовывают отсутствующий owner

what_changed.en: TCryptCertCng stores an explicit TSynLogClass, permits a nil TCryptCertAlgoCng owner for PFX instances and derives system-store status from the owner instead of dereferencing it.
what_changed.fr: TCryptCertCng stocke un TSynLogClass explicite, accepte un owner nil pour les PFX et déduit l’origine store de l’owner sans le déréférencer.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertCng 保存显式 TSynLogClass，允许 PFX instance 使用 nil TCryptCertAlgoCng owner，并从 owner 是否存在判断 system-store 状态。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertCng хранит явный TSynLogClass, допускает nil owner для PFX и определяет system-store status без его разыменования.

impact.en: TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 no longer risks a GPF while constructing or logging a transient certificate.
impact.fr: TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 ne risque plus un GPF lors de la construction ou du log.
impact.zh: TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 在构造或记录临时证书时不再可能 GPF。
impact.ru: TCryptCertCng.LoadPkcs12 больше не рискует GPF при создании или логировании временного сертификата.

action_detail.en: Upgrade before deploying the new transient PFX factory.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau avant de déployer la nouvelle factory PFX.
action_detail.zh: 部署新的临时 PFX factory 前请升级。
action_detail.ru: Обновитесь до внедрения новой PFX factory.

headline.en: OpenSSL option masks use the correct 1.1 and 3.x widths
headline.fr: Les masques d’options OpenSSL utilisent les tailles 1.1 et 3.x
headline.zh: OpenSSL option mask 使用正确的 1.1 与 3.x 宽度
headline.ru: OpenSSL option masks используют правильную ширину 1.1 и 3.x

what_changed.en: SSL_CTX_set_options and SSL_CTX_clear_options now publish QWord masks and dispatch through 32-bit OpenSSL 1.1 or 64-bit OpenSSL 3 signatures; culong is introduced for unsigned C long values.
what_changed.fr: SSL_CTX_set_options/clear_options publient des masques QWord et appellent les signatures 32-bit OpenSSL 1.1 ou 64-bit OpenSSL 3 ; culong représente unsigned C long.
what_changed.zh: SSL_CTX_set_options 与 SSL_CTX_clear_options 公开 QWord mask，并按 OpenSSL 1.1 的 32-bit 或 OpenSSL 3 的 64-bit signature 分派；新增 culong。
what_changed.ru: SSL_CTX_set_options/clear_options публикуют QWord mask и выбирают 32-bit signature OpenSSL 1.1 или 64-bit OpenSSL 3; добавлен culong.

impact.en: OpenSSL 3 option bits are no longer truncated, while OpenSSL 1.1 keeps its native ABI.
impact.fr: Les bits d’options OpenSSL 3 ne sont plus tronqués et OpenSSL 1.1 conserve son ABI.
impact.zh: OpenSSL 3 option bit 不再被截断，同时 OpenSSL 1.1 保持其原生 ABI。
impact.ru: Option bits OpenSSL 3 больше не обрезаются, а OpenSSL 1.1 сохраняет свой ABI.

action_detail.en: Retest TLS context options on both OpenSSL 1.1 and 3.x.
action_detail.fr: Retestez les options TLS sous OpenSSL 1.1 et 3.x.
action_detail.zh: 在 OpenSSL 1.1 与 3.x 上重新测试 TLS context option。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте TLS context options на OpenSSL 1.1 и 3.x.

headline.en: OpenSSL error-queue codes get a platform-width type
headline.fr: Les codes de la queue OpenSSL ont un type adapté à la plateforme
headline.zh: OpenSSL 错误队列代码使用平台宽度类型
headline.ru: Коды OpenSSL error queue получили платформенный тип

what_changed.en: TErrQueueCode aliases culong; ERR_get_error, ERR_error_string_n and OpenSSL_error wrappers use it, while EOpenSsl.LastError becomes PtrInt to hold SSL or queue codes.
what_changed.fr: TErrQueueCode alias culong ; ERR_get_error, ERR_error_string_n et OpenSSL_error l’utilisent, et EOpenSsl.LastError devient PtrInt.
what_changed.zh: TErrQueueCode 作为 culong 别名；ERR_get_error、ERR_error_string_n 与 OpenSSL_error wrapper 改用该类型，EOpenSsl.LastError 改为 PtrInt。
what_changed.ru: TErrQueueCode — alias culong; ERR_get_error, ERR_error_string_n и OpenSSL_error используют его, EOpenSsl.LastError стал PtrInt.

impact.en: 64-bit POSIX error-queue values are preserved instead of truncating to 32 bits. Low-level error helper signatures change.
impact.fr: Les valeurs de queue POSIX 64-bit ne sont plus tronquées. Les signatures des helpers bas niveau changent.
impact.zh: 64-bit POSIX 错误队列值不再截断为 32-bit；低层错误 helper signature 有变化。
impact.ru: 64-bit POSIX error-queue values больше не обрезаются до 32 bit; signatures низкоуровневых helpers изменены.

action_detail.en: Recompile code that calls OpenSSL_error helpers or reads EOpenSsl.LastError into integer.
action_detail.fr: Recompilez le code appelant OpenSSL_error ou stockant EOpenSsl.LastError dans integer.
action_detail.zh: 重编译调用 OpenSSL_error helper 或把 EOpenSsl.LastError 存入 integer 的代码。
action_detail.ru: Пересоберите код, вызывающий OpenSSL_error или сохраняющий EOpenSsl.LastError в integer.

headline.en: RSA envelope opening can delegate the private operation
headline.fr: L’ouverture d’enveloppe RSA peut déléguer l’opération privée
headline.zh: RSA envelope 解密可委托私钥操作
headline.ru: Открытие RSA-envelope может делегировать private operation

what_changed.en: mormot.crypt.rsa adds TRsaPkcs1Decrypt and RsaOpen to validate the shared envelope, delegate PKCS#1 v1.5 key decryption and perform AES decryption; TRsa.Open now reuses it.
what_changed.fr: mormot.crypt.rsa ajoute TRsaPkcs1Decrypt et RsaOpen pour valider l’enveloppe, déléguer le déchiffrement PKCS#1 v1.5 et effectuer AES ; TRsa.Open le réutilise.
what_changed.zh: mormot.crypt.rsa 新增 TRsaPkcs1Decrypt 与 RsaOpen，用于验证 envelope、委托 PKCS#1 v1.5 key 解密并完成 AES 解密；TRsa.Open 复用它。
what_changed.ru: mormot.crypt.rsa добавляет TRsaPkcs1Decrypt и RsaOpen для проверки envelope, делегирования PKCS#1 v1.5 decrypt и AES; TRsa.Open переиспользует функцию.

impact.en: External private-key providers such as CNG and PKCS#11 can open the same TRsa.Seal format without exporting the RSA key.
impact.fr: Les providers CNG et PKCS#11 peuvent ouvrir le format TRsa.Seal sans exporter la clé RSA.
impact.zh: CNG 与 PKCS#11 等外部私钥 provider 可在不导出 RSA key 的情况下解密相同 TRsa.Seal 格式。
impact.ru: CNG и PKCS#11 могут открывать формат TRsa.Seal без экспорта RSA key.

action_detail.en: Use RsaOpen only with a callback that performs RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 unpadding and returns the ephemeral key.
action_detail.fr: Utilisez RsaOpen avec un callback qui effectue l’unpadding RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 et renvoie la clé éphémère.
action_detail.zh: 仅应为 RsaOpen 提供执行 RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 unpadding 并返回临时 key 的 callback。
action_detail.ru: Используйте RsaOpen только с callback, выполняющим RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5 unpadding и возвращающим ephemeral key.

headline.en: Windows CNG decrypts one RSA PKCS#1 block
headline.fr: Windows CNG déchiffre un bloc RSA PKCS#1
headline.zh: Windows CNG 解密单个 RSA PKCS#1 block
headline.ru: Windows CNG расшифровывает один RSA PKCS#1 block

what_changed.en: TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1 wraps NCryptDecrypt with PKCS#1 padding, optional silent mode, one hardware operation, bounded output and cleanup on error.
what_changed.fr: TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1 encapsule NCryptDecrypt avec padding PKCS#1, mode silent, une seule opération hardware, sortie bornée et nettoyage sur erreur.
what_changed.zh: TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1 封装 NCryptDecrypt，使用 PKCS#1 padding、可选 silent mode、单次硬件操作、受限输出并在错误时清理。
what_changed.ru: TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1 оборачивает NCryptDecrypt с PKCS#1 padding, optional silent mode, одной hardware operation, bounded output и cleanup при ошибке.

impact.en: CNG-backed RSA keys, including hardware KSP keys, gain the primitive needed for envelope decryption without a size-query operation.
impact.fr: Les clés RSA CNG, y compris hardware KSP, obtiennent le primitive nécessaire au déchiffrement d’enveloppe sans requête de taille.
impact.zh: CNG 支持的 RSA key（包括硬件 KSP）获得 envelope 解密所需 primitive，且无需额外 size query。
impact.ru: CNG-backed RSA keys, включая hardware KSP, получают primitive для envelope decryption без size query.

headline.en: CNG private keys can open RSA-encrypted framework messages
headline.fr: Les clés privées CNG ouvrent les messages RSA du framework
headline.zh: CNG 私钥可解密框架 RSA 消息
headline.ru: CNG private keys открывают RSA-сообщения framework

what_changed.en: TCryptPrivateKeyCng.Open decodes the AES cipher name, derives the RSA modulus size and uses RsaOpen plus TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1; key acquisition and logging are shared with signing.
what_changed.fr: TCryptPrivateKeyCng.Open décode le cipher AES, calcule le modulus RSA et utilise RsaOpen avec TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1 ; acquisition et log sont partagés avec la signature.
what_changed.zh: TCryptPrivateKeyCng.Open 解码 AES cipher 名、取得 RSA modulus size，并结合 RsaOpen 与 TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1；key 获取与日志复用签名路径。
what_changed.ru: TCryptPrivateKeyCng.Open декодирует AES cipher, определяет RSA modulus и использует RsaOpen с TNCrypt.KeyDecryptPkcs1; key acquisition/logging общие с signing.

impact.en: ICryptCertCng.Open now decrypts TRsa.Seal-compatible messages with store or hardware keys that remain non-exportable.
impact.fr: ICryptCertCng.Open déchiffre les messages compatibles TRsa.Seal avec des clés de store ou hardware non exportables.
impact.zh: ICryptCertCng.Open 现在可用仍不可导出的 store 或硬件 key 解密兼容 TRsa.Seal 的消息。
impact.ru: ICryptCertCng.Open расшифровывает TRsa.Seal-compatible messages через неэкспортируемые store/hardware keys.

action_detail.en: Test Open with every AES cipher name and CNG provider used by the application.
action_detail.fr: Testez Open avec chaque cipher AES et provider CNG de l’application.
action_detail.zh: 使用应用实际采用的每个 AES cipher 名与 CNG provider 测试 Open。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте Open со всеми AES cipher names и CNG providers приложения.

headline.en: Remaining OpenSSL unsigned-long declarations are narrowed
headline.fr: Les derniers unsigned long OpenSSL sont corrigés
headline.zh: 其余 OpenSSL unsigned-long 声明得到修正
headline.ru: Оставшиеся OpenSSL unsigned-long declarations исправлены

what_changed.en: mormot.lib.openssl11 corrects additional culong-facing signatures and separates SSL error integers from TErrQueueCode, while keeping flag-only cardinal declarations where OpenSSL caps constants at 32 bits.
what_changed.fr: mormot.lib.openssl11 corrige d’autres signatures culong et sépare les erreurs SSL integer des TErrQueueCode, tout en gardant cardinal pour les flags 32-bit.
what_changed.zh: mormot.lib.openssl11 修正更多 culong signature，并区分 SSL integer error 与 TErrQueueCode；常量限制为 32-bit 的 flag 仍使用 cardinal。
what_changed.ru: mormot.lib.openssl11 исправляет ещё несколько culong signatures и отделяет SSL integer errors от TErrQueueCode, сохраняя cardinal для 32-bit flags.

impact.en: OpenSSL error reporting and option wrappers align with their actual C domains across platforms.
impact.fr: Le reporting d’erreurs et les wrappers d’options s’alignent sur leurs domaines C réels.
impact.zh: OpenSSL 错误报告与 option wrapper 在各平台上对齐实际 C 类型域。
impact.ru: OpenSSL error reporting и option wrappers соответствуют реальным C domains на всех платформах.

action_detail.en: Take this final declaration pass with the preceding OpenSSL ABI commits.
action_detail.fr: Prenez ce dernier passage avec les commits ABI OpenSSL précédents.
action_detail.zh: 请将此最终声明修正与前述 OpenSSL ABI commit 一起采用。
action_detail.ru: Берите этот финальный declaration pass вместе с предыдущими OpenSSL ABI commits.

headline.en: RSA envelope header has one shared definition
headline.fr: L’en-tête d’enveloppe RSA a une définition partagée
headline.zh: RSA envelope header 统一为单一定义
headline.ru: RSA envelope header получил единое определение

what_changed.en: TRsaSealHeader and PRsaSealHeader move to mormot.core.os.security so pure Pascal RSA and OpenSSL use the identical packed layout; RsaOpen takes its callback as const.
what_changed.fr: TRsaSealHeader et PRsaSealHeader passent dans mormot.core.os.security afin que RSA Pascal et OpenSSL partagent le même layout packed ; le callback RsaOpen devient const.
what_changed.zh: TRsaSealHeader 与 PRsaSealHeader 移至 mormot.core.os.security，使纯 Pascal RSA 与 OpenSSL 使用完全相同的 packed layout；RsaOpen callback 改为 const。
what_changed.ru: TRsaSealHeader и PRsaSealHeader перенесены в mormot.core.os.security, чтобы Pascal RSA и OpenSSL использовали один packed layout; callback RsaOpen стал const.

impact.en: Envelope compatibility is centralized with no wire-format change. Code importing the newly public header should use mormot.core.os.security.
impact.fr: La compatibilité d’enveloppe est centralisée sans changer le wire format. Le type public se trouve dans mormot.core.os.security.
impact.zh: envelope 兼容性得到集中定义，wire format 不变；需要公开 header 类型的代码应导入 mormot.core.os.security。
impact.ru: Envelope compatibility централизована без изменения wire format. Публичный header находится в mormot.core.os.security.

headline.en: PKCS#11 private keys can open RSA envelopes
headline.fr: Les clés privées PKCS#11 ouvrent les enveloppes RSA
headline.zh: PKCS#11 私钥可解密 RSA envelope
headline.ru: PKCS#11 private keys открывают RSA-envelope

what_changed.en: TPkcs11.Decrypt wraps C_DecryptInit/C_Decrypt, and TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11.Open uses CKM_RSA_PKCS with RsaOpen to decrypt the framework RSA/AES envelope through a token private key.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11.Decrypt encapsule C_DecryptInit/C_Decrypt et TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11.Open utilise CKM_RSA_PKCS avec RsaOpen via la clé privée du token.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11.Decrypt 封装 C_DecryptInit/C_Decrypt；TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11.Open 结合 CKM_RSA_PKCS 与 RsaOpen，通过 token 私钥解密框架 RSA/AES envelope。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11.Decrypt оборачивает C_DecryptInit/C_Decrypt, а TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11.Open использует CKM_RSA_PKCS и RsaOpen через private key token.

impact.en: Hardware-token RSA keys can decrypt ICryptPrivateKey.Open messages without exporting private material.
impact.fr: Les clés RSA de token peuvent déchiffrer ICryptPrivateKey.Open sans exporter de secret.
impact.zh: 硬件 token RSA key 可解密 ICryptPrivateKey.Open 消息，无需导出私钥材料。
impact.ru: RSA keys аппаратного token могут расшифровывать ICryptPrivateKey.Open без экспорта private material.

action_detail.en: Verify that each target token permits CKM_RSA_PKCS decryption for the selected key.
action_detail.fr: Vérifiez que chaque token autorise CKM_RSA_PKCS decryption pour la clé choisie.
action_detail.zh: 确认每个目标 token 允许所选 key 执行 CKM_RSA_PKCS 解密。
action_detail.ru: Убедитесь, что каждый token разрешает CKM_RSA_PKCS decryption для выбранного key.

headline.en: X.509 lookup accepts human-formatted thumbprints
headline.fr: La recherche X.509 accepte les thumbprints lisibles
headline.zh: X.509 查找接受人类可读 thumbprint
headline.ru: X.509 lookup принимает human-formatted thumbprints

what_changed.en: TX509.FingerPrintCompare becomes case-insensitive and InternalFind normalizes ccmSha1/ccmSha256 values such as space- or colon-separated Windows clipboard thumbprints.
what_changed.fr: TX509.FingerPrintCompare devient insensible à la casse et InternalFind normalise les valeurs ccmSha1/ccmSha256 séparées par espaces ou deux-points.
what_changed.zh: TX509.FingerPrintCompare 改为大小写不敏感，InternalFind 规范化空格或冒号分隔的 Windows clipboard ccmSha1/ccmSha256 thumbprint。
what_changed.ru: TX509.FingerPrintCompare стал case-insensitive, InternalFind нормализует ccmSha1/ccmSha256 с пробелами или двоеточиями из Windows clipboard.

impact.en: Certificate searches accept common administrator-entered thumbprint forms instead of silently missing the certificate.
impact.fr: Les recherches acceptent les formats de thumbprint courants au lieu de rater silencieusement le certificat.
impact.zh: 证书搜索现在接受常见管理员输入 thumbprint 格式，不再静默找不到证书。
impact.ru: Certificate search принимает обычные административные формы thumbprint вместо тихого пропуска.

headline.en: Thumbprint normalization reaches every certificate backend
headline.fr: La normalisation des thumbprints couvre tous les backends certificat
headline.zh: Thumbprint 规范化覆盖所有证书后端
headline.ru: Нормализация thumbprint охватывает все certificate backends

what_changed.en: TCryptCert.InternalFind, TCryptCert.Compare and TX509.FingerPrintCompare use HumanHexCompare for SHA-1/SHA-256 digest matching, centralizing separators and case handling.
what_changed.fr: TCryptCert.InternalFind, Compare et TX509.FingerPrintCompare utilisent HumanHexCompare pour SHA-1/SHA-256, centralisant séparateurs et casse.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCert.InternalFind、Compare 与 TX509.FingerPrintCompare 使用 HumanHexCompare 进行 SHA-1/SHA-256 匹配，统一处理分隔符与大小写。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCert.InternalFind, Compare и TX509.FingerPrintCompare используют HumanHexCompare для SHA-1/SHA-256, централизуя separators и case.

impact.en: Human-formatted digest matching behaves consistently for X.509, CNG and PKCS#11 certificate implementations.
impact.fr: La comparaison de digest formaté est cohérente pour X.509, CNG et PKCS#11.
impact.zh: 人类格式 digest 匹配在 X.509、CNG 与 PKCS#11 证书实现间保持一致。
impact.ru: Human-formatted digest matching одинаков для X.509, CNG и PKCS#11.

headline.en: PKCS#11 RSA-PSS signing supplies the required parameters
headline.fr: La signature RSA-PSS PKCS#11 fournit les paramètres requis
headline.zh: PKCS#11 RSA-PSS 签名提供所需参数
headline.ru: PKCS#11 RSA-PSS signing передаёт обязательные параметры

what_changed.en: Pkcs11SetPssParams builds CK_RSA_PKCS_PSS_PARAMS with the matching hash, MGF1 and salt length; SignDigest sends the raw digest for PSS instead of a PKCS#1 DigestInfo.
what_changed.fr: Pkcs11SetPssParams construit CK_RSA_PKCS_PSS_PARAMS avec hash, MGF1 et salt length ; SignDigest envoie le digest brut pour PSS au lieu d’un DigestInfo PKCS#1.
what_changed.zh: Pkcs11SetPssParams 构造包含匹配 hash、MGF1 与 salt length 的 CK_RSA_PKCS_PSS_PARAMS；SignDigest 对 PSS 发送 raw digest，而非 PKCS#1 DigestInfo。
what_changed.ru: Pkcs11SetPssParams строит CK_RSA_PKCS_PSS_PARAMS с hash, MGF1 и salt length; SignDigest отправляет raw digest для PSS вместо PKCS#1 DigestInfo.

impact.en: Hardware tokens can produce valid PS256, PS384 and PS512 signatures rather than rejecting or mis-encoding the operation.
impact.fr: Les tokens peuvent produire des signatures PS256/384/512 valides au lieu de rejeter ou mal encoder l’opération.
impact.zh: 硬件 token 现在可生成有效 PS256、PS384 与 PS512 签名，不再拒绝或错误编码操作。
impact.ru: Hardware tokens могут создавать корректные PS256/PS384/PS512 signatures вместо отказа или неверного encoding.

action_detail.en: Verify PSS signatures against an independent verifier for every deployed token.
action_detail.fr: Vérifiez les signatures PSS avec un vérificateur indépendant pour chaque token.
action_detail.zh: 对每个部署 token 使用独立 verifier 验证 PSS 签名。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте PSS signatures независимым verifier для каждого token.

headline.en: PKCS#11 signs ES384, ES512 and ES256K in DER form
headline.fr: PKCS#11 signe ES384, ES512 et ES256K au format DER
headline.zh: PKCS#11 以 DER 格式签名 ES384、ES512 与 ES256K
headline.ru: PKCS#11 подписывает ES384, ES512 и ES256K в DER

what_changed.en: SignDigest converts raw r||s output with SetSignatureSecurityRaw for ES256, ES384, ES512 and ES256K, and ensures the PSS mechanism field is populated.
what_changed.fr: SignDigest convertit la sortie r||s via SetSignatureSecurityRaw pour ES256/384/512/256K et renseigne le mechanism PSS.
what_changed.zh: SignDigest 对 ES256、ES384、ES512 与 ES256K 使用 SetSignatureSecurityRaw 转换 raw r||s 输出，并确保设置 PSS mechanism。
what_changed.ru: SignDigest преобразует raw r||s через SetSignatureSecurityRaw для ES256/384/512/256K и заполняет PSS mechanism.

impact.en: Tokens with larger or secp256k1 EC keys now return the DER signature form expected by ICryptPrivateKey.
impact.fr: Les tokens avec clés EC plus grandes ou secp256k1 renvoient le format DER attendu par ICryptPrivateKey.
impact.zh: 使用更大 EC 或 secp256k1 key 的 token 现在返回 ICryptPrivateKey 期望的 DER 签名格式。
impact.ru: Tokens с большими EC или secp256k1 keys возвращают DER signature, ожидаемую ICryptPrivateKey.

action_detail.en: Add token-backed signature tests for every enabled ES algorithm.
action_detail.fr: Ajoutez des tests de signature token pour chaque algorithme ES activé.
action_detail.zh: 为每个启用的 ES 算法添加 token-backed 签名测试。
action_detail.ru: Добавьте token-backed signature tests для каждого ES algorithm.

headline.en: PKCS#11 private keys validate algorithm and digest before use
headline.fr: Les clés privées PKCS#11 valident algorithme et digest avant usage
headline.zh: PKCS#11 私钥在使用前验证算法与 digest
headline.ru: PKCS#11 private keys проверяют algorithm и digest до использования

what_changed.en: TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11 initializes fKeyAlgo from X.509, rejects mismatched signing algorithms or digest lengths and derives RSA modulus eligibility from the key algorithm rather than the selected signature algorithm.
what_changed.fr: TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11 initialise fKeyAlgo depuis X.509, rejette les algorithmes/digests incompatibles et déduit RSA du type de clé.
what_changed.zh: TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11 从 X.509 初始化 fKeyAlgo，拒绝不匹配的签名算法或 digest 长度，并根据 key algorithm 而非选中 signature algorithm 判断 RSA modulus。
what_changed.ru: TCryptPrivateKeyPkcs11 инициализирует fKeyAlgo из X.509, отвергает несовместимый algorithm/digest и определяет RSA modulus по key algorithm.

impact.en: Invalid combinations fail cleanly before opening a token session; RSA-PSS keys remain usable for envelope opening when appropriate.
impact.fr: Les combinaisons invalides échouent avant d’ouvrir une session ; les clés RSA-PSS restent utilisables pour Open si approprié.
impact.zh: 无效组合在打开 token session 前安全失败；适用时 RSA-PSS key 仍可用于 envelope Open。
impact.ru: Неверные комбинации завершаются до открытия token session; RSA-PSS keys остаются пригодны для envelope Open.

headline.en: Windows CryptoAPI AES provider setup is streamlined
headline.fr: L’initialisation du provider AES CryptoAPI est simplifiée
headline.zh: Windows CryptoAPI AES provider 初始化简化
headline.ru: Настройка Windows CryptoAPI AES provider упрощена

what_changed.en: mormot.crypt.win simplifies the PROV_RSA_AES provider state check and local trailer XOR helper without changing its public AES classes.
what_changed.fr: mormot.crypt.win simplifie le contrôle d’état PROV_RSA_AES et le helper XOR final sans changer les classes publiques.
what_changed.zh: mormot.crypt.win 简化 PROV_RSA_AES provider 状态检查与尾部 XOR helper，不改变公开 AES 类。
what_changed.ru: mormot.crypt.win упрощает проверку состояния PROV_RSA_AES и trailer XOR helper без изменения public AES classes.

impact.en: No application-code impact; the same CryptoAPI AES modes and errors remain exposed.
impact.fr: Aucun impact applicatif ; les mêmes modes AES et erreurs restent exposés.
impact.zh: 应用代码无影响；公开的 CryptoAPI AES mode 与错误保持不变。
impact.ru: Нет влияния на application code; доступны те же CryptoAPI AES modes и errors.

headline.en: PKCS#11 locking moves from the low-level engine to the catalog
headline.fr: Le verrouillage PKCS#11 passe du moteur bas niveau au catalogue
headline.zh: PKCS#11 加锁从低层 engine 移至 catalog
headline.ru: PKCS#11 locking перенесён из low-level engine в catalog

what_changed.en: TPkcs11 changes from TObjectOSLock to TSynPersistent and removes internal locking. TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 gains a reentrant TOSLock plus public Lock and UnLock methods protecting its shared engine and background load.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11 passe de TObjectOSLock à TSynPersistent et retire ses locks internes. TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 gagne un TOSLock réentrant et les méthodes publiques Lock/UnLock.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11 从 TObjectOSLock 改继承 TSynPersistent，并移除内部加锁；TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 新增可重入 TOSLock 与公开 Lock/UnLock，保护共享 engine 与后台加载。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11 меняет базу TObjectOSLock на TSynPersistent и удаляет internal locking. TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 получает reentrant TOSLock и public Lock/UnLock.

impact.en: Direct TPkcs11 instances are explicitly not thread-safe. Concurrent callers that relied on Engine.Safe or implicit session serialization can race or corrupt shared session state.
impact.fr: Les instances TPkcs11 directes ne sont plus thread-safe. Les appels concurrents qui dépendaient de Engine.Safe ou de la sérialisation implicite peuvent entrer en race.
impact.zh: 直接 TPkcs11 instance 明确不再 thread-safe；依赖 Engine.Safe 或隐式 session 串行化的并发调用可能竞态或破坏共享 session 状态。
impact.ru: Прямые TPkcs11 instances теперь не thread-safe. Параллельные вызовы, полагавшиеся на Engine.Safe/implicit serialization, могут повредить shared session state.

action_detail.en: Grep for shared TPkcs11 and Engine.Safe use. Serialize catalog operations with TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock or provide one engine per thread.
action_detail.fr: Recherchez les TPkcs11 partagés et Engine.Safe. Sérialisez via TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock ou utilisez un moteur par thread.
action_detail.zh: 搜索共享 TPkcs11 与 Engine.Safe；用 TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock 串行化 catalog 操作，或每线程使用独立 engine。
action_detail.ru: Найдите shared TPkcs11 и Engine.Safe. Сериализуйте через TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Lock/UnLock либо используйте engine на thread.

headline.en: PKCS#11 shutdown waits for background discovery
headline.fr: Le shutdown PKCS#11 attend la découverte en arrière-plan
headline.zh: PKCS#11 shutdown 等待后台发现完成
headline.ru: PKCS#11 shutdown ждёт background discovery

what_changed.en: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 retains its TLoggedWorkThread with manual wait, frees it before the engine and moves completion notification into a finally block while holding the catalog lock.
what_changed.fr: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 conserve son TLoggedWorkThread, l’attend avant de libérer le moteur et place la notification de fin dans finally sous lock.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 保留带 manual wait 的 TLoggedWorkThread，在释放 engine 前先 free/wait，并在持锁 finally 中设置完成状态。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11 хранит TLoggedWorkThread с manual wait, освобождает его до engine и устанавливает completion в finally под lock.

impact.en: Destroying the catalog during slow library initialization no longer lets the loader touch freed memory and cause a GPF.
impact.fr: Détruire le catalogue pendant une initialisation lente ne laisse plus le loader accéder à de la mémoire libérée et provoquer un GPF.
impact.zh: 在缓慢 library 初始化期间销毁 catalog 不再允许 loader 访问已释放内存并导致 GPF。
impact.ru: Destroy catalog во время медленной library initialization больше не приводит loader к freed memory и GPF.

action_detail.en: Stress shutdown while PKCS#11 library loading and token enumeration are still in progress.
action_detail.fr: Stressez le shutdown pendant le chargement et l’énumération PKCS#11.
action_detail.zh: 对 PKCS#11 library 加载与 token 枚举尚未完成时的 shutdown 进行压力测试。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте shutdown во время загрузки PKCS#11 library и перечисления token.

headline.en: PKCS#11 import returns the stored certificate and rolls back failures
headline.fr: L’import PKCS#11 renvoie le certificat stocké et annule les échecs
headline.zh: PKCS#11 导入返回已存证书并在失败时回滚
headline.ru: PKCS#11 import возвращает сохранённый сертификат и откатывает ошибки

what_changed.en: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Import validates hexadecimal ID, creates certificate and private-key objects, reloads the actual certificate, adds it to the catalog and destroys partial objects in reverse order on failure.
what_changed.fr: Import valide l’ID hexa, crée certificat et clé, recharge le certificat réel, l’ajoute au catalogue et détruit les objets partiels en ordre inverse si nécessaire.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Import 验证十六进制 ID，创建证书与私钥对象，重新加载实际证书并加入 catalog；失败时按逆序销毁部分对象。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Import проверяет hex ID, создаёт certificate/private-key objects, перечитывает сертификат, добавляет его в catalog и откатывает partial objects в обратном порядке.

impact.en: Successful imports become immediately usable and failures no longer leave orphaned token objects.
impact.fr: Les imports réussis sont immédiatement utilisables et les échecs ne laissent plus d’objets orphelins.
impact.zh: 成功导入后可立即使用；失败不再留下孤立 token object。
impact.ru: Успешный import сразу доступен, ошибки не оставляют orphan token objects.

action_detail.en: Retest successful import, invalid ID, private-key failure and rollback on each HSM.
action_detail.fr: Retestez succès, ID invalide, échec de clé et rollback sur chaque HSM.
action_detail.zh: 在每个 HSM 上测试成功导入、无效 ID、私钥失败与回滚。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте success, invalid ID, private-key failure и rollback на каждом HSM.

headline.en: PKCS#11 private-key attributes follow each X.509 algorithm
headline.fr: Les attributs de clé PKCS#11 suivent chaque algorithme X.509
headline.zh: PKCS#11 私钥属性按各 X.509 算法转换
headline.ru: PKCS#11 private-key attributes соответствуют каждому X.509 algorithm

what_changed.en: CryptCertToPkcs11PrivKeyAttributes refines RSA/ECC attribute conversion and key-usage flags when translating an ICryptCert for token import.
what_changed.fr: CryptCertToPkcs11PrivKeyAttributes affine la conversion des attributs RSA/ECC et des flags d’usage lors de l’import token.
what_changed.zh: CryptCertToPkcs11PrivKeyAttributes 在将 ICryptCert 转为 token import 时修正 RSA/ECC 属性与 key-usage flag。
what_changed.ru: CryptCertToPkcs11PrivKeyAttributes уточняет RSA/ECC attributes и key-usage flags при import ICryptCert в token.

impact.en: Imported token keys carry attributes consistent with their certificate algorithm, improving HSM acceptance and later lookup.
impact.fr: Les clés importées portent des attributs cohérents avec l’algorithme, améliorant l’acceptation HSM et les recherches.
impact.zh: 导入 token 的 key 属性与证书算法保持一致，提高 HSM 接受度与后续查找可靠性。
impact.ru: Imported token keys получают attributes, согласованные с certificate algorithm, улучшая HSM acceptance и lookup.

action_detail.en: Reimport test RSA and EC identities and inspect token attributes.
action_detail.fr: Réimportez des identités RSA et EC de test et inspectez les attributs.
action_detail.zh: 重新导入测试 RSA 与 EC identity，并检查 token 属性。
action_detail.ru: Повторно импортируйте тестовые RSA/EC identities и проверьте token attributes.

headline.en: PKCS#11 rejects signature algorithms incompatible with the real key
headline.fr: PKCS#11 rejette les algorithmes incompatibles avec la vraie clé
headline.zh: PKCS#11 拒绝与实际 key 不兼容的签名算法
headline.ru: PKCS#11 отвергает signature algorithms, несовместимые с реальным key

what_changed.en: TCryptCertPkcs11.SetAsymAlgo checks the X.509 SubjectPublicKeyAlgorithm: unrestricted RSA accepts RS/PSS, RSA-PSS stays PSS-only and ECC must keep its curve-compatible family.
what_changed.fr: SetAsymAlgo vérifie SubjectPublicKeyAlgorithm : RSA libre accepte RS/PSS, RSA-PSS reste PSS-only et ECC doit rester compatible avec sa courbe.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertPkcs11.SetAsymAlgo 检查 X.509 SubjectPublicKeyAlgorithm：普通 RSA 接受 RS/PSS，RSA-PSS 仅允许 PSS，ECC 必须保持曲线兼容。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertPkcs11.SetAsymAlgo проверяет X.509 SubjectPublicKeyAlgorithm: обычный RSA допускает RS/PSS, RSA-PSS остаётся PSS-only, ECC требует совместимую curve.

impact.en: Algorithm switches can no longer authorize an invalid signing mechanism merely because enum families happened to map alike.
impact.fr: Un changement d’algorithme ne peut plus autoriser un mécanisme invalide sur la seule base d’un mapping d’enum.
impact.zh: 算法切换不再仅因 enum family 映射相同而错误允许无效 signing mechanism。
