impact.ru: Algorithm switch больше не разрешает неверный signing mechanism только из-за совпадения enum mapping.

action_detail.en: Test every SetAsymAlgo transition used with RSA, RSA-PSS and EC token keys.
action_detail.fr: Testez chaque transition SetAsymAlgo pour les clés RSA, RSA-PSS et EC.
action_detail.zh: 测试所有用于 RSA、RSA-PSS 与 EC token key 的 SetAsymAlgo 转换。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте все переходы SetAsymAlgo для RSA, RSA-PSS и EC token keys.

headline.en: PKCS#11 signing sends data during the size query and always closes
headline.fr: La signature PKCS#11 envoie les données au size query et ferme toujours
headline.zh: PKCS#11 签名在 size query 时发送数据并始终关闭 session
headline.ru: PKCS#11 signing передаёт data при size query и всегда закрывает session

what_changed.en: TPkcs11.Sign passes Data and Len to the first C_Sign call instead of nil/zero. SignDigest wraps exceptions for tracing and moves engine.Close into finally; CAA_PSS centralizes PSS membership.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11.Sign passe Data/Len au premier C_Sign au lieu de nil/zero. SignDigest trace les exceptions et ferme le moteur dans finally ; CAA_PSS centralise la famille PSS.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11.Sign 首次 C_Sign 调用改传 Data/Len，而非 nil/zero。SignDigest 捕获异常记录 trace，并在 finally 中关闭 engine；CAA_PSS 集中定义 PSS 集合。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11.Sign передаёт Data/Len в первый C_Sign вместо nil/zero. SignDigest логирует исключения и закрывает engine в finally; CAA_PSS задаёт семейство PSS.

impact.en: Tokens that require the real input for signature sizing work correctly, and failed signing no longer leaks an open session.
impact.fr: Les tokens exigeant les vraies données pour calculer la taille fonctionnent, et un échec ne laisse plus de session ouverte.
impact.zh: 需要真实输入来计算签名长度的 token 现可正常工作，签名失败也不再泄漏开放 session。
impact.ru: Tokens, которым нужны реальные data для размера signature, работают; ошибка signing больше не оставляет открытую session.

action_detail.en: Retest signing success and injected token errors, verifying sessions close in both cases.
action_detail.fr: Retestez signature et erreurs injectées en vérifiant la fermeture des sessions.
action_detail.zh: 重新测试签名成功与注入 token 错误，确认两种情况下 session 都关闭。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте success и injected token errors, убедившись в закрытии sessions.

headline.en: PKCS#11 GetObject returns the single matching record
headline.fr: PKCS#11 GetObject renvoie l’unique record correspondant
headline.zh: PKCS#11 GetObject 返回唯一匹配 record
headline.ru: PKCS#11 GetObject возвращает единственный matching record

what_changed.en: TPkcs11.GetObject finalizes and clears its output, requires exactly one GetObjects result and assigns that record to Info before copying an optional value.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11.GetObject finalise puis vide la sortie, exige exactement un résultat et assigne ce record à Info avant la valeur optionnelle.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11.GetObject 先 finalize/清空输出，要求 GetObjects 恰有一个结果，并在复制可选 value 前把该 record 赋给 Info。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11.GetObject finalizes/очищает output, требует ровно один результат и присваивает record в Info до optional value.

impact.en: Import and lookup callers receive initialized object metadata instead of a success flag with stale or empty Info.
impact.fr: Les appels d’import et lookup reçoivent des métadonnées initialisées au lieu d’un succès avec Info vide ou ancien.
impact.zh: import 与 lookup 调用方现在获得初始化的 object 元数据，不再成功返回却留下过期或空 Info。
impact.ru: Import/lookup callers получают инициализированные object metadata вместо success со stale/empty Info.

action_detail.en: Retest token import and any direct TPkcs11.GetObject call.
action_detail.fr: Retestez l’import token et les appels directs TPkcs11.GetObject.
action_detail.zh: 重新测试 token import 与任何直接 TPkcs11.GetObject 调用。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте token import и прямые TPkcs11.GetObject calls.

headline.en: PKCS#11 unload finalizes only initialized libraries
headline.fr: PKCS#11 UnLoad finalise seulement les bibliothèques initialisées
headline.zh: PKCS#11 UnLoad 仅 finalize 已初始化 library
headline.ru: PKCS#11 UnLoad finalizes только инициализированные libraries

what_changed.en: TPkcs11.Load tracks fInitialized after C_Initialize, cleans up each failure stage, and UnLoad calls C_Finalize only when initialization actually succeeded.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11.Load suit fInitialized après C_Initialize, nettoie chaque échec et UnLoad n’appelle C_Finalize qu’après une vraie initialisation.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11.Load 在 C_Initialize 后跟踪 fInitialized，清理每个失败阶段；UnLoad 仅在初始化确实成功时调用 C_Finalize。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11.Load отслеживает fInitialized после C_Initialize, очищает каждый failure stage, а UnLoad вызывает C_Finalize только после успешной initialization.

impact.en: Failed library loads no longer finalize an uninitialized API or leak a partially opened library handle.
impact.fr: Un chargement échoué ne finalise plus une API non initialisée et ne fuit plus un handle partiel.
impact.zh: library 加载失败不再 finalize 未初始化 API，也不再泄漏部分打开的 library handle。
impact.ru: Неудачный library load больше не finalizes неинициализированный API и не оставляет partial handle.

action_detail.en: Exercise missing symbols, C_Initialize failure, unsupported Cryptoki version and normal unload.
action_detail.fr: Testez symboles manquants, échec C_Initialize, version Cryptoki non prise en charge et unload normal.
action_detail.zh: 测试缺失 symbol、C_Initialize 失败、不支持的 Cryptoki version 与正常 unload。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте missing symbols, C_Initialize failure, unsupported Cryptoki version и normal unload.

headline.en: PKCS#11 bad signature lengths return false instead of raising
headline.fr: Une mauvaise longueur de signature PKCS#11 renvoie false
headline.zh: PKCS#11 错误签名长度返回 false 而非抛异常
headline.ru: Неверная длина PKCS#11 signature возвращает false

what_changed.en: TPkcs11.Verify treats CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE like CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID and returns false; other token errors still raise EPkcs11.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11.Verify traite CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE comme CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID et renvoie false ; les autres erreurs restent fatales.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11.Verify 将 CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE 与 CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID 一样处理并返回 false；其他 token 错误仍抛 EPkcs11。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11.Verify обрабатывает CKR_SIGNATURE_LEN_RANGE как CKR_SIGNATURE_INVALID и возвращает false; другие token errors по-прежнему raise EPkcs11.

impact.en: Malformed-length signatures are ordinary verification failures instead of operational HSM exceptions.
impact.fr: Les signatures de mauvaise longueur deviennent un échec de vérification ordinaire, pas une exception HSM.
impact.zh: 长度异常签名现在是普通验证失败，而非 HSM 操作异常。
impact.ru: Signatures неверной длины становятся обычным verification failure, а не HSM exception.

headline.en: PKCS#11 import logs in with the normal user PIN
headline.fr: L’import PKCS#11 utilise le PIN utilisateur normal
headline.zh: PKCS#11 导入使用普通 user PIN
headline.ru: PKCS#11 import использует обычный user PIN

what_changed.en: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Import renames SoPinCode to PinCode and opens a read/write CKU_USER session instead of a Security Officer session before creating certificate and private-key objects.
what_changed.fr: Import renomme SoPinCode en PinCode et ouvre une session read/write CKU_USER plutôt qu’une session Security Officer.
what_changed.zh: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Import 将 SoPinCode 改名为 PinCode，并在创建证书和私钥对象前打开 read/write CKU_USER session，而非 Security Officer session。
what_changed.ru: TCryptCertAlgoPkcs11.Import переименовывает SoPinCode в PinCode и открывает read/write CKU_USER session вместо Security Officer session.

impact.en: HSMs that reject object creation under the SO role can import with the intended normal user credentials.
impact.fr: Les HSM qui refusent la création sous le rôle SO peuvent importer avec les credentials utilisateur normaux.
impact.zh: 拒绝在 SO 角色下创建 object 的 HSM 现在可用预期普通用户凭据导入。
impact.ru: HSM, запрещающие создание objects под SO role, могут импортировать с обычными user credentials.

action_detail.en: Supply the normal user PIN to Import and retest permissions; do not pass the SO PIN.
action_detail.fr: Passez le PIN utilisateur normal à Import et retestez les permissions ; n’utilisez pas le PIN SO.
action_detail.zh: 向 Import 提供普通 user PIN 并重新测试权限；不要传 SO PIN。
action_detail.ru: Передавайте в Import обычный user PIN и проверьте permissions; не используйте SO PIN.

headline.en: PKCS#11 object enumeration always finalizes its search
headline.fr: L’énumération PKCS#11 finalise toujours sa recherche
headline.zh: PKCS#11 object 枚举始终 finalize 搜索
headline.ru: PKCS#11 object enumeration всегда finalizes поиск

what_changed.en: TPkcs11.GetObjects wraps FindObjects in try/finally, records C_FindObjectsFinal, runs it on exceptions and validates the final status after cleanup.
what_changed.fr: TPkcs11.GetObjects enveloppe FindObjects dans try/finally, appelle toujours C_FindObjectsFinal et vérifie son statut après nettoyage.
what_changed.zh: TPkcs11.GetObjects 用 try/finally 包裹 FindObjects，记录并始终调用 C_FindObjectsFinal，清理后验证最终状态。
what_changed.ru: TPkcs11.GetObjects оборачивает FindObjects в try/finally, всегда вызывает C_FindObjectsFinal и проверяет final status после cleanup.

impact.en: Enumeration failures no longer leave an active find operation that breaks later token calls.
impact.fr: Un échec d’énumération ne laisse plus une opération find active qui casse les appels suivants.
impact.zh: 枚举失败不再留下 active find operation 而破坏后续 token 调用。
impact.ru: Enumeration failure больше не оставляет active find operation, ломающую последующие token calls.

action_detail.en: Test attribute-read failures followed by another object search in the same session.
action_detail.fr: Testez un échec de lecture d’attribut suivi d’une autre recherche dans la même session.
action_detail.zh: 测试 attribute 读取失败后在同一 session 中再次搜索 object。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте attribute-read failure и следующий object search в той же session.

headline.en: Socket retry timing is expressed as one deadline
headline.fr: Le timing des retries socket utilise une seule échéance
headline.zh: Socket 重试时序改用单一 deadline
headline.ru: Socket retry timing выражен единым deadline

what_changed.en: TrySockRecv computes an end tick and remaining time, separates nrOk and RecvPending fast paths, and keeps AcceptEx context setup inside the accept-state lock. A redundant PKCS#11 initializer is removed.
what_changed.fr: TrySockRecv calcule une échéance et le temps restant, sépare nrOk et RecvPending et garde AcceptEx sous le lock ; un initializer PKCS#11 redondant disparaît.
what_changed.zh: TrySockRecv 计算结束 tick 与剩余时间，分离 nrOk 和 RecvPending 快速路径，并在 accept-state lock 内完成 AcceptEx context 设置；同时删除冗余 PKCS#11 initializer。
what_changed.ru: TrySockRecv вычисляет deadline/remaining, разделяет nrOk и RecvPending fast paths и держит AcceptEx context setup под lock; удалён redundant PKCS#11 initializer.

impact.en: The prior timeout and IOCP fixes keep their behavior with clearer invariants and atomic accept finalization.
impact.fr: Les correctifs timeout et IOCP gardent leur comportement avec des invariants plus clairs et une finalisation atomique.
impact.zh: 此前 timeout 与 IOCP 修复保持行为不变，同时获得更清晰 invariant 与原子 accept finalization。
impact.ru: Предыдущие timeout/IOCP fixes сохраняют поведение с ясными invariants и atomic accept finalization.

headline.en: JSON escaping stops reading past the supplied buffer
headline.fr: L’échappement JSON cesse de lire après le buffer fourni
headline.zh: JSON 转义停止读取输入 buffer 之外内容
headline.ru: JSON escaping больше не читает за пределами buffer

what_changed.en: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer fixes an inverted MaxLen comparison: it now truncates Len when Len exceeds MaxLen instead of extending Len up to MaxLen.
what_changed.fr: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer corrige la comparaison MaxLen inversée : Len est tronqué s’il dépasse MaxLen au lieu d’être agrandi.
what_changed.zh: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer 修正颠倒的 MaxLen 比较：当 Len 超过 MaxLen 时截断，而非把 Len 扩大到 MaxLen。
what_changed.ru: TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer исправляет перевёрнутое сравнение MaxLen: Len теперь обрезается, а не увеличивается до MaxLen.

impact.en: Logging invalid UTF-8 or binary content no longer copies unrelated heap bytes into logs or raises an access violation while the log lock is held.
impact.fr: Logger du UTF-8 invalide ou du binaire ne copie plus des octets heap étrangers et ne provoque plus d’AV sous le lock de log.
impact.zh: 记录无效 UTF-8 或二进制内容时不再把无关 heap byte 写入日志，也不再在持有 log lock 时触发 access violation。
impact.ru: Логирование invalid UTF-8/binary content больше не копирует чужие heap bytes в log и не вызывает access violation под log lock.

action_detail.en: Upgrade immediately where untrusted or binary values can reach TSynLog.LogText or TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer; test truncation at TextTruncateAtLength.
action_detail.fr: Mettez à niveau immédiatement si des valeurs non fiables atteignent TSynLog.LogText ou AddEscapeBuffer ; testez TextTruncateAtLength.
action_detail.zh: 若不可信或二进制值可到达 TSynLog.LogText 或 TJsonWriter.AddEscapeBuffer，请立即升级并测试 TextTruncateAtLength 截断。
action_detail.ru: Срочно обновитесь, если недоверенные/binary values достигают TSynLog.LogText или AddEscapeBuffer; проверьте TextTruncateAtLength.

headline.en: HTTP sockets expose separate connect, send and receive timeouts
headline.fr: Les sockets HTTP séparent les timeouts connect, send et receive
headline.zh: HTTP socket 分别公开 connect、send 与 receive timeout
headline.ru: HTTP sockets разделяют connect, send и receive timeouts

what_changed.en: THttpClientSocket adds fConnectTimeout/fSendTimeout/fReceiveTimeout and public SetTimeouts. OpenBind temporarily applies the connect budget, then installs send and receive socket timeouts and restores the high-level wait value.
what_changed.fr: THttpClientSocket ajoute trois champs et SetTimeouts. OpenBind applique temporairement connect, puis installe send/receive et restaure le timeout haut niveau.
what_changed.zh: THttpClientSocket 新增三个 timeout 字段与公开 SetTimeouts。OpenBind 临时应用 connect budget，随后设置 send/receive socket timeout 并恢复高层等待值。
what_changed.ru: THttpClientSocket добавляет три timeout fields и public SetTimeouts. OpenBind временно применяет connect budget, затем устанавливает send/receive и восстанавливает high-level wait.

impact.en: Backends can give connection establishment a short limit while allowing different request-write and response-read budgets. The old constructor still initializes all three to one value.
impact.fr: Les backends peuvent limiter la connexion tout en donnant des budgets différents à l’écriture et la lecture. L’ancien constructeur initialise les trois pareillement.
impact.zh: 后端可给连接建立较短限制，同时为请求写入与响应读取配置不同预算；旧 constructor 仍把三者初始化为同一值。
impact.ru: Backend может ограничить connect отдельно от write/read budgets. Старый constructor по-прежнему задаёт одно значение всем трём.

action_detail.en: Set explicit phase budgets where connection and response latency differ, then test proxy CONNECT and retries.
action_detail.fr: Définissez des budgets distincts si les latences diffèrent, puis testez proxy CONNECT et retries.
action_detail.zh: 若连接与响应延迟不同，请设置各阶段明确预算，并测试 proxy CONNECT 与 retry。
action_detail.ru: Задайте отдельные budgets при разной connect/response latency и проверьте proxy CONNECT/retries.

headline.en: REST HTTP clients apply all three timeout settings
headline.fr: Les clients REST HTTP appliquent les trois timeouts
headline.zh: REST HTTP client 应用全部三个 timeout
headline.ru: REST HTTP clients применяют все три timeout

what_changed.en: TRestHttpClientSocket now calls fSocket.SetTimeouts(fConnectTimeout, fSendTimeout, fReceiveTimeout) immediately after creating its THttpClientSocket.
what_changed.fr: TRestHttpClientSocket appelle SetTimeouts avec connect/send/receive juste après la création de THttpClientSocket.
what_changed.zh: TRestHttpClientSocket 创建 THttpClientSocket 后立即调用 fSocket.SetTimeouts(fConnectTimeout, fSendTimeout, fReceiveTimeout)。
what_changed.ru: TRestHttpClientSocket вызывает fSocket.SetTimeouts с connect/send/receive сразу после создания THttpClientSocket.

impact.en: Configured REST send and receive timeouts are no longer collapsed into the connect timeout on the underlying socket.
impact.fr: Les timeouts REST send/receive configurés ne sont plus réduits au timeout connect du socket.
impact.zh: 配置的 REST send/receive timeout 不再在底层 socket 上被折叠为 connect timeout。
impact.ru: Настроенные REST send/receive timeouts больше не заменяются connect timeout underlying socket.

action_detail.en: Retest REST calls with deliberately different connect, send and receive limits.
action_detail.fr: Retestez REST avec des limites connect, send et receive volontairement différentes.
action_detail.zh: 使用刻意不同的 connect、send 与 receive 限制重新测试 REST 调用。
action_detail.ru: Перепроверьте REST calls с разными connect/send/receive limits.

headline.en: PKCS#11 certificate import uses valid flags and recognizes P-521
headline.fr: L’import certificat PKCS#11 utilise les bons flags et reconnaît P-521
headline.zh: PKCS#11 证书导入使用正确 flag 并识别 P-521
headline.ru: PKCS#11 certificate import использует правильные flags и распознаёт P-521

what_changed.en: AddSessionCertificate stops forcing posExtractable, always supplies CKA_SUBJECT and required private/ID values. Pkcs11KeyAlgorithm recognizes 528-bit coordinate storage as xkaEcc512 for secp521r1.
what_changed.fr: AddSessionCertificate ne force plus posExtractable, fournit toujours CKA_SUBJECT et les valeurs requises. Pkcs11KeyAlgorithm reconnaît les coordonnées 528-bit de secp521r1.
what_changed.zh: AddSessionCertificate 不再强制 posExtractable，始终提供 CKA_SUBJECT 与必需 private/ID 值；Pkcs11KeyAlgorithm 将 secp521r1 的 528-bit coordinate storage 识别为 xkaEcc512。
what_changed.ru: AddSessionCertificate больше не навязывает posExtractable, всегда задаёт CKA_SUBJECT и обязательные values. Pkcs11KeyAlgorithm распознаёт 528-bit coordinates secp521r1 как xkaEcc512.

impact.en: Tokens receive a valid CKO_CERTIFICATE template, and P-521 public keys are classified correctly during import and discovery.
impact.fr: Les tokens reçoivent un template CKO_CERTIFICATE valide et les clés P-521 sont correctement classées.
impact.zh: token 获得有效 CKO_CERTIFICATE template，P-521 公钥在导入与发现时得到正确分类。
impact.ru: Tokens получают валидный CKO_CERTIFICATE template, P-521 public keys правильно классифицируются.

action_detail.en: Reimport a certificate on each HSM and add a P-521 discovery/signing test where supported.
action_detail.fr: Réimportez un certificat sur chaque HSM et ajoutez un test P-521 si pris en charge.
action_detail.zh: 在每个 HSM 上重新导入证书，并在支持时添加 P-521 发现/签名测试。
action_detail.ru: Повторно импортируйте certificate на каждом HSM и добавьте P-521 discovery/signing test.

headline.en: PKCS#11 public keys are rebuilt from algorithm-specific attributes
headline.fr: Les clés publiques PKCS#11 sont reconstruites depuis leurs attributs
headline.zh: PKCS#11 公钥从算法特定属性重建
headline.ru: PKCS#11 public keys восстанавливаются из algorithm-specific attributes

what_changed.en: Pkcs11PublicKey first tries CKA_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO, then rebuilds RSA from modulus/exponent, EC from CKA_EC_POINT and Ed25519 from raw or legacy DER point data. TCryptCertPkcs11.Create uses it instead of treating CKA_VALUE as public key material.
what_changed.fr: Pkcs11PublicKey essaie CKA_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO puis reconstruit RSA, EC et Ed25519 depuis leurs attributs. TCryptCertPkcs11.Create ne traite plus CKA_VALUE comme clé publique.
what_changed.zh: Pkcs11PublicKey 先尝试 CKA_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO，再从 modulus/exponent 重建 RSA、从 CKA_EC_POINT 重建 EC，并从 raw 或旧 DER point 重建 Ed25519；TCryptCertPkcs11.Create 不再把 CKA_VALUE 当公钥材料。
what_changed.ru: Pkcs11PublicKey сначала пробует CKA_PUBLIC_KEY_INFO, затем восстанавливает RSA, EC и Ed25519 из их attributes. TCryptCertPkcs11.Create больше не считает CKA_VALUE public key material.

impact.en: Token identities without CKO_CERTIFICATE or with restricted CKA_VALUE expose the correct public key, avoiding unusable fake X.509 instances.
impact.fr: Les identités sans CKO_CERTIFICATE ou CKA_VALUE lisible exposent la bonne clé publique au lieu d’un faux X.509 inutilisable.
impact.zh: 没有 CKO_CERTIFICATE 或 CKA_VALUE 受限的 token identity 现在公开正确公钥，避免不可用的 fake X.509 instance。
impact.ru: Token identities без CKO_CERTIFICATE или с restricted CKA_VALUE получают правильный public key вместо unusable fake X.509.

action_detail.en: Test discovery for RSA, P-256/P-384/P-521 and Ed25519 public-key objects on each token.
action_detail.fr: Testez la découverte des objets RSA, P-256/P-384/P-521 et Ed25519 sur chaque token.
action_detail.zh: 在每个 token 上测试 RSA、P-256/P-384/P-521 与 Ed25519 公钥对象发现。
action_detail.ru: Проверьте discovery RSA, P-256/P-384/P-521 и Ed25519 public-key objects на каждом token.

headline.en: Ed25519 PKCS#8 private keys follow RFC 8410 nesting
headline.fr: Les clés privées Ed25519 PKCS#8 suivent l’imbrication RFC 8410
headline.zh: Ed25519 PKCS#8 私钥按 RFC 8410 嵌套解析
headline.ru: Ed25519 PKCS#8 private keys следуют вложенности RFC 8410

what_changed.en: SeqToEccPrivKey now parses PKCS#8 Ed25519 as id-Ed25519 followed by an outer privateKey OCTET STRING containing the inner RFC 8410 OCTET STRING, while retaining RFC 5915 EC handling.
what_changed.fr: SeqToEccPrivKey parse Ed25519 PKCS#8 comme id-Ed25519 suivi d’un OCTET STRING externe contenant l’OCTET STRING RFC 8410 interne, tout en gardant RFC 5915 pour EC.
what_changed.zh: SeqToEccPrivKey 现在按 RFC 8410 解析 PKCS#8 Ed25519：id-Ed25519 后是外层 privateKey OCTET STRING，其中包含内层 OCTET STRING；同时保留 RFC 5915 EC 处理。
what_changed.ru: SeqToEccPrivKey разбирает PKCS#8 Ed25519 как id-Ed25519 и внешний privateKey OCTET STRING с внутренним RFC 8410 OCTET STRING, сохраняя RFC 5915 для EC.

impact.en: Ed25519 private-key extraction yields the actual 32-byte key instead of failing or interpreting the wrong ASN.1 shape, enabling correct PKCS#11 import.
impact.fr: L’extraction Ed25519 renvoie les 32 octets réels au lieu d’échouer ou de lire une mauvaise forme ASN.1, permettant l’import PKCS#11 correct.
impact.zh: Ed25519 私钥提取现在得到实际 32-byte key，不再失败或误解 ASN.1 结构，从而可正确导入 PKCS#11。
impact.ru: Ed25519 private-key extraction возвращает реальные 32 bytes вместо ошибки/неверной ASN.1 формы, обеспечивая корректный PKCS#11 import.

action_detail.en: Reimport an RFC 8410 Ed25519 PKCS#8 key and verify a token-backed signature.
action_detail.fr: Réimportez une clé Ed25519 PKCS#8 RFC 8410 et vérifiez une signature token.
action_detail.zh: 重新导入 RFC 8410 Ed25519 PKCS#8 key，并验证 token-backed 签名。
action_detail.ru: Повторно импортируйте RFC 8410 Ed25519 PKCS#8 key и проверьте token-backed signature.
